name: arakiBrowLines
draws: A pale ground with one thick ink brow that kinks at the middle and thins to a point at the outer end, and two thin curved crease lines below.
params: uArkRage: 0 level brow to 1 inner end dropped toward the nose and outer end raised; uArkBrowSkin: ground colour.
doc: heavy angular tapered brow and two under-eye crease lines, the brow slope set by a rage value
functions: float arakiBrowSeg(vec2 q, vec2 a, vec2 b, float wa, float wb)

name: arakiCelRamp
draws: A sphere in three flat tones: a pale pink lit band, a mid pink and a deeper violet-leaning shade, with hard edges between them.
params: uArkBase: coat colour; uArkHue: radians the shade is rotated (shade turns violet); uArkCut: N.L thresholds of shade-to-mid and mid-to-lit.
doc: three-tone cel ramp whose shade is darkened, saturated and hue-rotated, lit lifted toward plaster

name: arakiColourShift
draws: The same picture repainted in four flat palette colours that jump to a new hue family every few drawings, like a JoJo colour-shift panel.
params: uArkPalA-D: dark-to-light band colours; uArkSpin: radians of hue rotation added per hold; uArkHold: drawings (12 fps ticks) per hold.
doc: remaps the four value bands of a plate to flat palette colours and rotates the hue by a fixed angle every hold

name: arakiContactBlob
draws: Two flat rose-brown oval shadows on cream plaster, each with a slightly ragged edge and a darker oval core.
params: uArkBlobA, uArkBlobB: x, y centre then x, y radius of each shadow; uArkBlobCol: shadow colour.
doc: hard-edged ragged contact shadow in two flat steps, an outer rose-brown pool and a darker core

name: arakiFurClump
draws: A blue-grey sphere whose shaded left side is covered in rows of dark triangular fur points of uneven length, none on the lit side.
params: uArkFurAng: direction the clump tips point, radians (112.5 degrees is 1.963); uArkFurSize: clump size in frame-height units.
doc: rows of pointed dark fur clumps with ragged tip lengths, gated to the shadow side
functions: vec3 arakiFurClumpC(vec3 col, vec2 p, float shade)

name: arakiKanaRow
draws: A row of chunky orange katakana characters with a thick ink outline and a hard black-brown drop shadow, upper half of each stroke lighter, the row tipping left and right twelve times a second.
params: uArkWord: 0 ゴゴゴ, 1 ザ・ワールド, 2 ドドド; uArkKanaAt: lower-left of the word; uArkKanaSize: glyph height; uArkKanaWeight: stroke half-width in glyph units; uArkKanaTilt: radians flipped on twos; uArkKanaFill, uArkKanaBg: colours.
doc: katakana sound words drawn as stroke segments (ゴゴゴ, ザ・ワールド, ドドド) in orange with ink outline and hard offset shadow, tilt flipping on twos

name: arakiKit
draws: A shared helper with no picture of its own; the other araki tools call it.
params: no uniforms; constants ARK_INK, ARK_PLASTER, ARK_GOLD, ARK_SINOPIA, ARK_ORANGE
doc: araki helpers: studio palette, arkCap luma cap 0.92 with ink floor, hard-edge AA, hue rotation, segment distance, demo plate
functions: float arkSeg(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b)

name: arakiNegativeFrame
draws: The whole picture flipped to a flat four-value negative with shifted hues, except one round patch that keeps its true colour.
params: uArkKeep: x, y and radius of the disc left un-inverted (radius 0 for none); uArkNegHue: radians the negative is rotated; uArkNeg: 1 when the negative is held.
doc: held negative: hue-rotated inverse posterised to four values, with a hard-edged disc left in normal colour

name: arakiRimBand
draws: A blue-grey sphere in two tones with one hard gold band along its right edge and a thin cream line inside the band.
params: uArkRimDir: world light direction the rim comes from; uArkRimCol: band colour; uArkRimK: fresnel power (bigger is thinner).
doc: one hard gold rim band on the Stand side of a form, with a narrower cream core for the emissive mask

name: arakiSealEye
draws: A pale blue-grey ground with a dark round eye holding a green spoked iris and a small glint, a heavy double lid line above and three short strokes below.
params: uArkIris: iris colour; uArkEyeSkin: fur colour around the eye; uArkLid: 0 open to 1 shut; uArkGold: 0 cream catchlight to 1 gold.
doc: seal lens eye: dark round lens, coloured spoked iris, heavy double lid, hatched under-eye, cream catchlight that turns gold

name: arakiStepGlow
draws: A dark plum field with a gold light made of three flat rings, brightest in the middle, with wobbly edges that twitch twice a second.
params: uArkGlowAt: light centre; uArkGlowR: radii of the core, middle and outer steps; uArkGlowCol: light colour (add before the luma cap).
doc: light as three hard concentric steps with a ragged edge, outer step hue-shifted, pulsing on twos; no soft falloff
functions: vec3 arakiStepGlowC(vec3 base, vec2 p, float t)

name: arakiTrowelGround
draws: A cream plaster wall made of square-ish trowel patches, each tilted a little and finely streaked, some warmer ochre or rose, with a faint ridge between patches.
params: uArkSeed2: which patch pattern; uArkSwath: patch size in frame-height units.
doc: static plaster laid in angled trowel swaths: per-swath tone step, fine streaks along the stroke, ridge at each swath edge

name: arakiTwosGrain
draws: A fine speckle over the picture, strongest in the dark areas, that changes twelve times a second, over a faint fixed paper pitting.
params: uArkCells: grain cells across p (frame pixels); uArkAmp: moving grain amount; uArkTooth: fixed paper tooth amount; uArkSeed: pattern seed.
doc: film grain re-rolled 12 times a second and weighted to the shadows, plus a static paper tooth
functions: vec3 arakiTwosGrainC(vec3 c, vec2 p, float t)

name: basicKit
doc: shared house look: 3-step cel, warm key / cool fill, indigo ink, luma cap 0.92, printed paper
functions: float bkBand(float v, float a, float b)
draws: A demo sphere in three flat cel tones on printed paper with an indigo outline; the module itself adds no picture and only supplies the shared look.
params: No arguments. Provides palette constants BK_KEY, BK_FILL, BK_MID, BK_INK and helpers bkCap (luma cap 0.92), bkAA (anti-aliased step), bkNdL, bkCel3, bkPaper, bkToner, bkBayer2/4/8, bkBlue, bkMixInk.

name: celCheek
doc: cheek blush plate: a soft oval keyed on facing, never a multiply stain
functions: vec3 celCheek(vec3 col, vec2 p, float facing)
draws: A soft pink oval of blush on a cheek, faded in where the face turns toward the light.
params: col: colour to tint; p: surface position, oval centred at (0.58, 0.42); facing: gate 0 to 1, blush shows where high.

name: celCloth
doc: cloth ramp: lower threshold, cooler fill, harder crease than skin
draws: Cloth in dusky plum and cool indigo folds, with a hard crease where the light stops.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; cuts at 0.32 and 0.70; dye and fold colours fixed.

name: celFace
doc: face ramp: higher threshold so cheeks stay lit, warm mid, no hard cloth cut
draws: A face in warm skin tones with the cheeks kept bright and a soft mid shade.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; cuts at 0.58 and 0.84; skin and shade colours fixed.

name: celHair
doc: hair cel: dark mass, one broken highlight band like a drawn zigzag
draws: A dark hair mass with a warm band of light broken into thin strands around the head.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; p: position used for strand angle (18 strands per turn); ring cut at 0.78.

name: celHalfLambert
doc: half-Lambert field quantised to the house 3-step, no raw cosine facets
draws: A three-tone sphere lit from the upper left, identical to celHard3 driven by a half-Lambert field.
params: N: surface normal; L: light direction; the half-Lambert term is fed to the 3-step cel.

name: celHard2
doc: hard 2-step cel: one fwidth cut between cool fill and warm key
draws: A sphere split into two flat tones, cool shadow and warm key, with one clean edge between them.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; one cut at 0.5 with fwidth anti-aliasing.

name: celHard3
doc: hard 3-step house cel: fill, mid, key with two razor bands
draws: A sphere in three flat tones, fill, mid and key, with two clean bands between them.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; cuts at 0.38 and 0.72 inside bkCel3.

name: celHard5
doc: hard 5-step cel: four cuts, each tone a printed plate
draws: A sphere in five stepped tones, each band a crisp printed plate.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; quantised to five tones with four anti-aliased cuts (width 0.75 of fwidth).

name: celIris
doc: iris cel: radial rings, dark limbus, one catchlight disc
draws: A stylised eye with a dark ringed blue-teal iris and a small white catchlight.
params: q: position relative to the iris centre, scaled; rings at radius 0.08, 0.22 and 0.62; catchlight fixed at (-0.12, 0.14).

name: celKnee
doc: highlight knee: mids hold, then a crushed specular rolloff under the luma cap
draws: A sphere whose mid tones hold, then a bright highlight rolls off in a sharp knee at the top.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; mid ramp 0.30 to 0.62; knee starts at 0.72 with power 2.4; cut at 0.35.

name: celMetal
doc: metal cel: dark body, hard specular sheet, indigo bounce in the fill
draws: A dark steel sphere with a hard white specular sheet on one side.
params: h: light term sets the body grey; spec: highlight intensity; sheet cut at 0.62 with fwidth edge.

name: celOvercast
doc: overcast: flattened two-band, almost no key, cool paper sky bounce
draws: A flat grey-blue two-tone surface with low light, like an overcast sky.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; fixed blue-grey and warm-grey pair; single cut at 0.48.

name: celPoster4
doc: 4-level poster: floor of a stepped field with AA on the fracture
draws: A sphere in four stepped tones, like a screen print.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; quantised to four levels with anti-aliased cuts (fwidth times 0.8).

name: celRimBand
doc: thin hard rim band on the light-facing back edge, not a Fresnel wash
functions: vec3 celRimBand(vec3 col, float nv, float facing)
draws: A thin bright band along the light-facing back edge of a shape.
params: col: base colour; nv: view-angle term; facing: gate; band centred at nv 0.86, strength 0.65.

name: celShadowLift
doc: shadow lift: fill never sinks to ink, a printed indigo floor
draws: Dark areas lifted to a printed indigo floor so shadows never go black.
params: col: input colour; luma range 0.04 to 0.18 controls how far shadows are lifted.

name: celSilk
doc: silk: a shifted anisotropic band, one bright thread plate
functions: vec3 celSilk(vec3 N, vec3 L, vec3 V)
draws: A satin sheen with one bright thread-like highlight band across a curved surface.
params: N, L, V: normal, light and view vectors; band exponent 18; highlight strength 0.5 at cut 0.55.

name: celSkin
doc: skin cel: warm subsurface mid, cool terminator, never a grey shadow
draws: A face-skin ramp with warm mid tones and cooler darker edges.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; wrap offset 0.14; cuts at 0.40 and 0.74; skin colours fixed.

name: celSoft
doc: soft smoothstep cel: wide terminator, still a 3-plate house grade
draws: A sphere in three tones with a wide, gentle edge between each band.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; smoothstep ranges 0.28 to 0.48 and 0.62 to 0.86.

name: celSpecSheet
doc: hard specular sheet: one lacquer plate, fwidth edge, under the luma cap
functions: vec3 celSpecSheet(vec3 col, float spec, float amount)
draws: A glossy highlight patch laid over the shaded colour, with a crisp edge.
params: col: shaded colour; spec: highlight term; amount: strength 0 to 1; edge at 0.55.

name: celSplitComp
doc: complementary split: key leans amber, fill leans teal, same value ladder
draws: A sphere lit amber on the key side and teal in the shadow.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; cuts at 0.40 and 0.74; teal and amber colours fixed.

name: celSunset
doc: sunset wrap: warm wrap past the terminator, cool sky in the core shadow
draws: A sphere with a red-orange wrap past the shadow edge and a blue-purple core.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; cuts at 0.28 and 0.68; core, wrap and key colours fixed.

name: celTwinTone
doc: twin-tone: only core shadow and a thin highlight plate, mid deleted
draws: A sphere with only a dark core shadow and a thin pale highlight, no middle tone.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; cuts at 0.34 (shadow) and 0.82 (highlight).

name: celUnder
doc: underlight: cool fill from below, warm key from above, two authored plates
draws: A surface lit warm from above and cool blue from below.
params: N: surface normal; key and fill directions fixed; blue fill weight 0.7.

name: celVelvet
doc: velvet: darkens toward the rim, lit only in the facing bowl
functions: vec3 celVelvet(vec3 N, vec3 V, float h)
draws: A deep purple-black surface that brightens only where it faces the viewer.
params: N: surface normal; V: view direction; h: light term 0 to 1; pile exponent 1.6.

name: celWarmKey
doc: warm-key / cold-fill split: hue flips at the terminator, value stays authored
draws: A sphere with a warm lit side and a cool shadow side, the hue flipping at the terminator.
params: h: light term 0 to 1; passes through bkWarmCool.

name: ditherBayer2
doc: Bayer 2x2 ordered dither of the house 3-step
draws: The image broken into a coarse 2x2 printed dot pattern of two colours.
params: col: colour, its luma sets the level; fc: pixel coordinate.

name: ditherBayer4
doc: Bayer 4x4 ordered dither, finer than 2x2, still a printed screen
draws: A finer 4x4 ordered halftone over the shaded image, with a mid tone between the two colours.
params: col: colour, luma sets the level; fc: pixel coordinate; mid-tone blend from the threshold.

name: ditherBayer8
doc: Bayer 8x8 ordered dither: the classic print screen
draws: The classic 8x8 print screen dithering the shaded image into two tones.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; blend 0.35 between hard step and smooth threshold.

name: ditherBlue
doc: blue-noise-ish hash dither: IGN mixed with a coarse cluster, less snow than white
functions: vec3 ditherBlue(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float seed)
draws: A grainy, less snowy halftone with soft clumps, like a printed screen.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; seed: animates the pattern, held at 12 Hz by the demo.

name: ditherChecks
doc: checker ordered dither: 2px checks as a crude print screen
draws: A crude checkerboard of two-pixel squares replacing the shading.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; luma thresholds 0.33 and 0.66 on alternating checks.

name: ditherCluster
doc: clustered-dot: dots grow from cell centres like a newspaper screen
draws: A newspaper-style halftone where dots grow from cell centres as the shading brightens.
params: col: colour, luma sets dot radius from 0.08 to 0.62; fc: pixel coordinate; cell size 8 px.

name: ditherDiagonal
doc: diagonal ordered threshold, strokes instead of a Bayer grid
draws: Diagonal stroke lines replace the shading.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; stroke pitch 0.125.

name: ditherHash
doc: hash dither: white threshold from a seeded hash, held if t is stepped
functions: vec3 ditherHash(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float seed)
draws: A noisy speckle of white dots thresholded over the shading.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; seed: changes the speckle, held at 12 Hz by the demo.

name: ditherIgn
doc: IGN interleaved gradient noise as a dither threshold
functions: vec3 ditherIgn(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float seed)
draws: A fine interleaved-gradient grain pattern over the shading.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; seed: shifts the grain pattern.

name: ditherInterleave
doc: interleaved 4-pixel pattern, a cheap ordered screen
draws: A 4-pixel repeating pattern over the shading, like an old cheap screen.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; pattern width 4 px.

name: ditherOrdered3
doc: 3x3 ordered matrix, a different pitch from Bayer 2/4/8
draws: A 3x3 ordered dot grid over the shading, at a different pitch from the 2, 4 and 8 Bayer screens.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; fixed 3x3 threshold matrix.

name: ditherQuant4
doc: 4-level quantise then Bayer 8 residual, a poster plus screen
draws: The shading cut into four flat levels, with a Bayer-8 grain along each edge.
params: col: colour, luma quantised to four levels; fc: pixel coordinate; Bayer-8 residual.

name: ditherSpiral
doc: spiral-dot screen: threshold from polar cell index
draws: A spiral of dots winding outward from a fixed point near the corner of the frame.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; spiral centre fixed at pixel (64, 64); spiral pitch 0.8 and radial pitch 0.07.

name: ditherTri
doc: triangular-pdf dither: two hashes subtracted, softer grain than one hash
functions: vec3 ditherTri(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float seed)
draws: Soft film-style grain over the shading, a little smoother than a single hash.
params: col: colour; fc: pixel coordinate; seed: changes the grain, held at 12 Hz by the demo.

name: ditherVoid
doc: void-and-cluster-ish: sparse dots that avoid each other via two scales
draws: a field of sparse grey dots spread evenly over the shaded form, none touching their neighbours
params: col: input shade, luma sets dot density; fc: screen pixel coordinate; BK_FILL/BK_KEY: the two plate colours; blue-noise samples at two scales

name: gradeBleach
doc: bleach bypass: retain silver, crush chroma, keep the luma ladder
draws: the frame looks like a bleach-bypass print: colour drained toward silver with hard bright and dark ends
params: col: input colour; mixes 0.62 toward luma, then a smoothstep 0.2-0.8 splits the ends; constants fixed

name: gradeBlood
doc: blood plate: crimson fill, bone key
draws: the scene turns to a crimson plate with bone-white highlights
params: col: input colour; luma picks a dark-crimson, crimson, bone ramp; 0.8 blend back to source

name: gradeCoolStock
doc: cool film stock: cyan shadows, restrained highlights
draws: a film look with cyan-tinted shadows and calm highlights
params: col: input colour; fixed RGB gain 0.92/0.98/1.06 before the grade; smoothstep 0.25-0.8 on luma for the shadow tint

name: gradeCrush
doc: crushed mids: a harder S-curve, still lifted off ink
draws: midtones pushed into harder contrast, with the blacks held slightly off pure ink
params: col: input colour; luma lifted from 0.08 then mapped by a 1.35 power curve; ink floor fixed

name: gradeCyanotype
doc: cyanotype: Prussian blue plate, paper highlights
draws: the frame becomes a Prussian-blue print with pale paper-white highlights
params: col: input colour; luma picks a 3-stop ramp of dark ink, blue, paper; replaces colour fully

name: gradeDusk
doc: dusk: amber wrap, violet fill, the sun already gone
draws: the frame wrapped in violet shadow and amber highlights, as if the sun has just set
params: col: input colour; luma picks a violet-to-amber ramp (3 stops); 0.72 blend back to source

name: gradeEmber
doc: ember: near-black umber with a held warm coal in the mids
draws: a near-black umber frame with a glowing coal-orange band through the midtones
params: col: input colour; luma split at 0.45 between umber, coal and ember; 0.75 blend back to source

name: gradeGolden
doc: golden hour: key goes honey, fill stays earth, luma capped
draws: a warm honey wash over the frame that lifts the lights toward gold
params: col: input colour; luma picks an earth-to-honey ramp; 0.6 blend back to source

name: gradeIce
doc: ice: lifted cyan-grey, highlights stay glass not bloom
draws: a cold cyan-grey frame whose highlights read as glass rather than glow
params: col: input colour; luma picks a slate, grey-cyan, glass 3-stop ramp; 0.7 blend

name: gradeInkWash
doc: ink wash grade: one hue, value does the drawing
draws: the frame becomes monochrome ink on paper, darks as ink and lights as pale wash
params: col: input colour; luma only, pow 0.9, mapped from ink to a pale grey

name: gradeLiftFog
doc: lifted fog: a cool haze added by value, never a bloom
draws: a cool grey haze fills the darker parts of the frame and softens depth
params: col: input colour; haze grey (0.62,0.68,0.74) mixed in by inverse luma at strength 0.44

name: gradeMonoSafe
doc: mono-safe: luma plate on indigo/paper, no pure black
draws: a black-and-cream luma plate on indigo and paper that never goes to pure black
params: col: input colour; luma only, mix from indigo ink to warm paper

name: gradeMoon
doc: moonlight: cool key, green-silver mids, indigo floor
draws: a moonlit frame: cool silver midtones over an indigo floor
params: col: input colour; luma picks an indigo, green-silver, pale ramp; 0.78 blend

name: gradeNight
doc: night-grade: lifted indigo blacks, compressed highlights
draws: a night frame with indigo-lifted blacks and gently compressed highlights
params: col: input colour; lifts blacks toward indigo, compresses the top end, fixed blue cast; cut-local copies of this name exist under lib/anime/cutscenes

name: gradePastel
doc: pastel: chroma pulled, value lifted off the floor, still under 0.92
draws: a soft pastel frame, colour washed toward a light tint and never reaching full white
params: col: input colour; chroma pulled 0.45 toward grey, value lifted by 0.12, blend 0.7

name: gradePrint
doc: print-grade: magenta fill, green key, a split plate
draws: a magenta-and-green print plate where the light areas shift one way and the dark areas the other
params: col: input colour; two fixed channel gains blended by luma smoothstep 0.28-0.72; cut-local copies of this name exist under lib/anime/cutscenes

name: gradeSepia
doc: sepia-safe: brown plate that never sinks to #000 or blows past 0.92
draws: an antique brown photograph plate, dark brown ends to cream highlights
params: col: input colour; luma picks a dark-brown, brown, cream ramp; 0.85 blend back to source

name: gradeTealOrange
doc: teal-orange: fill pushed cyan, key pushed amber, value held
draws: teal shadows against warm amber lights, with the original brightness kept
params: col: input colour; pulled 0.55 toward a teal-to-amber ramp by luma, then rescaled to the source luma

name: gradeTechnicolor
doc: 3-strip: primaries pulled apart, then recapped so nothing milks
draws: a saturated three-strip film look with the primary colours pushed apart
params: col: input colour; per-channel power curves 0.85/0.9/0.8; 0.4 blend toward a shifted tint

name: gradeWarmStock
doc: warm film stock: yellow-red gain, mids stay brown not orange plastic
draws: a warm film look: yellow-red gain with brown midtones instead of orange plastic
params: col: input colour; fixed RGB gain 1.06/0.99/0.90; smoothstep 0.2-0.8 on luma to keep mids brown

name: hatchAraki
doc: Araki speed-shadow: thick parallel bands in the core, tapering, high contrast
functions: vec3 hatchAraki(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: thick parallel speed lines across the core of the shadow, tapering off toward the edges
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate, sets band axis and taper; s: shadow amount gating ink strength

name: hatchAshi
doc: ashiato: clustered footprint shadow under the form, not a hatch grid
functions: vec3 hatchAshi(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: a cluster of footprint-shaped dark marks under the form, like a trail of prints
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate, blob sits at 0.72,0.28; s: shadow amount scaling strength

name: hatchBlock
doc: solid manga black: a lifted indigo plate, not #000
draws: a flat solid inky-black area over the shadow, with no texture
params: col: input shade; s: shadow amount deciding how much turns to ink, anti-aliased

name: hatchCoarse
doc: coarse 20-ish lpi hatch: fat printed bars in deep shadow
functions: vec3 hatchCoarse(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float s)
draws: fat printed bars in the deepest shadow, like a coarse screen
params: col: input shade; fc: screen pixel coordinate; s: shadow amount; pitch fixed at 14 px, same stroke as hatchFine

name: hatchContour
doc: contour-following hatch: strokes run around the sphere, not screen-locked
functions: vec3 hatchContour(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: curved strokes that wrap around the form like contour lines on a sphere
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount gating stroke strength

name: hatchCross
doc: two-weight cross-hatch: one direction in mid-shadow, both in the core
functions: vec3 hatchCross(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float s, float ts)
draws: single-direction lines in mid-shadow that become a crosshatch in the deepest core
params: col: input shade; fc: screen pixel coordinate; s: shadow amount splitting the two directions; ts: stroke pitch

name: hatchDiag
doc: diagonal screen hatch in shadow only, printed stroke not noise
functions: vec3 hatchDiag(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float shadow, float ts)
draws: diagonal printed strokes that appear only in the shadow
params: col: input shade; fc: screen pixel coordinate; shadow: shadow amount; ts: stroke pitch, the same stroke as hatchFine with pitch as an argument

name: hatchDot30
doc: 30% Ben-Day: sparse toner, a light printed grey
draws: a light scatter of printed grey dots over the frame
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; dot coverage fixed at 0.28

name: hatchDot60
doc: 60% Ben-Day: large toner discs, a mid-grey plate
draws: larger dots covering most of the area, a mid-grey print plate
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; dot coverage fixed at 0.62, same toner as hatchDot30

name: hatchFine
doc: fine 60-ish lpi hatch, shadow only, tight printed pitch
functions: vec3 hatchFine(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float s)
draws: a tight fine-pitch line hatch laid over the shadow
params: col: input shade; fc: screen pixel coordinate, sets line direction; s: shadow amount gating ink strength; pitch fixed at 4.2 px

name: hatchFlame
doc: flame-shape shade: rising tongues in the core shadow
functions: vec3 hatchFlame(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: rising flame-like tongues of dark shading in the core shadow
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate, tongue origin at 0.72,0.42; s: shadow amount; fbm noise shapes the tongues

name: hatchGrad
doc: tone gradient dots: disc radius follows shadow amount
functions: vec3 hatchGrad(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: dots that grow larger as the shadow deepens
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount clamped to 0.05-0.85 to set dot radius

name: hatchLino
doc: linocut chunks: large carved blocks with ragged AA edges
functions: vec3 hatchLino(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: carved blocky cells in the shadow, like a linocut print
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount, also seeds which cells are cut

name: hatchMezzo
doc: mezzotint: pit density, a copper-plate grey, not white noise
functions: vec3 hatchMezzo(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: a grainy copper-plate grey that gets denser the darker the area
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount shifting the threshold; noise scale fixed at 55

name: hatchMoire
doc: moiré beat: two close pitches interfere, a print accident used as tone
functions: vec3 hatchMoire(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float s)
draws: a wavy interference banding in the shadow, like two printed screens beating together

name: hatchRain
doc: rain-line hatch: long vertical strokes, denser in shadow
functions: vec3 hatchRain(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: long vertical rain-like strokes in the shadow
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount; column jitter from a hash, fixed

name: hatchSai
doc: sai / ink wash: pooled pigment darker in the hollows, granulation not noise
functions: vec3 hatchSai(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: soft ink-wash pooling that is darker in the hollows, with a grainy texture
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount scaling darkness; fbm and granulation noise

name: hatchScribble
doc: scribble fill: short offset strokes, still a printed mass
functions: vec3 hatchScribble(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: loose short scribbled strokes filling the shadow as one printed mass
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount gating strength; per-cell random stroke offset

name: hatchSpeedOnly
doc: speed-shadow only: Araki bands with the fill deleted to paper
functions: vec3 hatchSpeedOnly(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: speed lines across the shadow with the fill removed, leaving paper
params: col: input shade; p: surface coordinate; s: shadow amount; same band construction as hatchAraki at a different angle and frequency

name: hatchStipple
doc: stipple / toner dots: Ben-Day discs in shadow, AA'd, printed scale
functions: vec3 hatchStipple(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: Shadowed areas turn into a screen of printed Ben-Day dots that grow denser toward the dark.
params: col: base colour; p: screen position; s: shadow amount, sets dot size and strength

name: hatchToneWin
doc: screentone window: a hard oval of toner over the house cel
functions: vec3 hatchToneWin(vec3 col, vec2 p, vec2 c, vec2 r)
draws: A hard oval window of toner dots sits over the cel, like a pasted screentone patch.
params: col: base colour; p: pixel position; c: window centre; r: window radii

name: hatchWeave
doc: screen weave: two rotated grids beating, a printed rosette not CGI noise
functions: vec3 hatchWeave(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: Two crossed dot grids beat against each other to form a printed rosette in the shadow.
params: col: base colour; p: position; s: shadow amount, sets strength

name: hatchWhite
doc: white-on-dark scratch: paper cuts through a dark plate
functions: vec3 hatchWhite(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float s)
draws: A dark ink plate with white diagonal scratches cut through it in the shadow.
params: col: base colour; fc: frame pixel coords; s: shadow amount, sets how much plate is inked

name: hatchWood
doc: woodcut: heavy parallel gouges, slightly wavy, umber ink
functions: vec3 hatchWood(vec3 col, vec2 p, float s)
draws: Heavy, slightly wavy umber gouges run across the surface like a woodcut block.
params: col: base colour; p: position; s: shadow amount, sets gouge strength

name: hatchZip
doc: zipper shade: staggered dashes that read as a manga zip
functions: vec3 hatchZip(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float s)
draws: Staggered short dashes in the shadow read as a manga zip tone.
params: col: base colour; fc: frame pixel coords; s: shadow amount, sets strength

name: inkBoil
doc: 12fps line boil: hashed silhouette jitter held on stepped time
functions: float inkBoil(vec2 p, float t, float px)
draws: The outline shivers on a steady 12-frames-per-second step, with a hand-drawn wobble.
params: p: position; t: time; px: line width in pixels

name: inkBroken
doc: broken contour: gaps where a hash along the line drops out
draws: The silhouette outline has gaps where stretches of it drop out entirely.
params: p: position; px: line width in pixels

name: inkBrush
doc: brush pressure: width follows a slow hash, like a loaded nib
draws: The outline swells and thins slowly around the form, like a loaded brush.
params: p: position; px: base width in pixels

name: inkContact
doc: contact line: a grounded occlusion stroke under the form
draws: A short dark stroke sits under the form where it meets the ground.
params: p: position; px: line width in pixels

name: inkCrease
doc: interior crease: ink where the lighting field crosses a mid threshold
functions: float inkCrease(float h, float level, float px)
draws: A dark line appears wherever the light falls across one chosen mid tone inside the form.
params: h: lighting value 0-1; level: threshold the line follows; px: width in pixels

name: inkDouble
doc: double contour: a tight inner ring plus a loose outer echo
draws: A tight inner ring is shown with a faint, looser echo ring outside it.
params: p: position; px: line width in pixels

name: inkDry
doc: dry brush: the line skips where paper tooth is high
draws: The outline skips where paper grain is high, so it looks drawn on rough stock.
params: p: position; px: line width in pixels

name: inkFat
doc: fat marker outline: a wide indigo plate around the hull
draws: A thick indigo ring surrounds the silhouette.
params: p: position; px: ring width scale (5.2 in demo)

name: inkHairline
doc: 0.75px hairline: the thinnest legal contour, still AA'd
draws: A very thin, constant-pixel ring outlines the silhouette.
params: p: position; width fixed at 0.75 px

name: inkHold8
doc: 8fps hold jitter: threes, a heavier boil than the 12fps line
functions: float inkHold8(vec2 p, float t, float px)
draws: The outline shivers on a slower 8-frames-per-second step with bigger jitter than the 12 fps line.
params: p: position; t: time; px: line width in pixels

name: inkHull
doc: inverted hull outline: a constant-pixel silhouette ring in indigo, never #000
draws: A clean constant-width indigo ring traces the silhouette.
params: p: position; px: width in pixels

name: inkIndigo
doc: deep indigo key line, lifted off black so the print still has air
draws: The key lines of the frame are pushed toward deep indigo instead of black.
params: col: base colour; k: ink amount 0-1

name: inkIsoRim
doc: iso rim: constant-pixel line on a level set of the lighting field
functions: float inkIsoRim(float f, float level, float px)
draws: A thin line follows one brightness contour inside the form.
params: f: lighting value; level: contour to follow; px: width in pixels

name: inkJag
doc: jagged clumps: noise along the rim breaks it into tapered hair tips
draws: The outline breaks into tapered clumps, like hair tips.
params: p: position; px: width scale

name: inkPressure
doc: pressure envelope: a sine load along the stroke, thick belly thin ends
draws: The outline is thick along its middle and thin at the ends, like pen pressure.
params: p: position; px: base width in pixels

name: inkQuill
doc: concave quill: line weight grows where the lighting field bends in
draws: The outline thickens where the lighting bends inward.
params: p: position; px: base width in pixels

name: inkRimKey
doc: rim-as-ink: the back edge is a dark key, not a lit Fresnel
draws: The back edge of the form becomes a dark ink key line instead of a glowing rim.
params: N: surface normal; V: view vector

name: inkSetDepth
doc: set-line: thicker where the sphere falls away from the lens, a depth-ish weight
draws: The outline thickens where the sphere turns away from the camera.
params: p: position; px: base width in pixels

name: inkSketch
doc: overlapping sketch passes: three slightly offset holds, printed not jittered every frame
functions: float inkSketch(vec2 p, float t, float px)
draws: Three slightly offset outline passes overlap, like a pencil sketch.
params: p: position; t: time; px: line width in pixels

name: inkSkip
doc: skip-tooth: contour punched through by paper grain so it reads drawn on stock
draws: The outline is punched through by paper grain so it looks printed on stock.
params: p: position; px: line width in pixels

name: inkSobel
doc: sobel / luma screen edge from neighboring lighting samples, fwidth-scaled taps
draws: A dark edge appears wherever neighbouring pixels differ sharply in light.
params: p: pixel position; fwidth-scaled tap distance from derivatives

name: inkTaper
doc: tapered stroke: width breathes along the silhouette, tails fade to a hairline
draws: The outline width breathes around the silhouette and tails off to a hairline.
params: p: position; px: base width in pixels

name: inkTinted
doc: coloured ink: albedo darkened and saturated, then mixed toward indigo
draws: Key lines take a colour tint: the albedo is darkened and saturated toward ink.
params: alb: albedo colour; k: ink amount 0-1

name: inkUmber
doc: umber key line: warm brown contour for earth plates
draws: The key line turns warm brown instead of indigo.
params: col: base colour; k: ink amount 0-1

name: inkWeight
doc: variable weight from curvature of N, thick in hollows, hairline on flats
draws: The outline is thick where the surface curves and hairline on flat areas.
params: p: position; px: base width in pixels

name: lineAction
doc: action streaks: short hashes that lean with motion, 12fps hold
draws: Short hashed streaks lean with the motion and change every 12 frames.
params: p: position; t: time for the 12 fps hold

name: lineBurst
doc: burst: short radial ticks around a hit, 12fps hold safe
functions: float lineBurst(vec2 p, vec2 at, float t)
draws: Short radial ticks burst outward from a hit point.
params: p: position; at: hit centre; t: time for the 12 fps hold

name: lineCaption
doc: caption rule: a thin bar in the lower third, paper-safe
draws: A thin horizontal rule sits in the lower third as a caption bar.
params: uv: panel coordinates

name: lineCircleFocus
doc: circle focus: concentric rules around the subject
draws: Concentric rings radiate around the subject.
params: p: position; at: ring centre

name: lineCorner
doc: corner ticks: four panel registration marks
draws: Small L-shaped registration ticks mark the four panel corners.
params: uv: panel coordinates; px: width in pixels

name: lineDoubleRule
doc: double rule: two parallel panel lines, a printed border
draws: Two parallel thin rules run along the frame edge as a printed border.
params: uv: panel coordinates

name: lineFadeEdge
doc: fade edge: vignette rule that dissolves into paper, not a black card
draws: The frame edges fade into paper colour rather than black.
params: col: frame colour; uv: frame coordinates

name: lineFocus
doc: focus lines: longer rays, a hole in the middle for the subject
draws: Long rays fan out from the subject and leave a clear hole in the middle.
params: p: position; at: focus centre

name: lineGutter
doc: gutter: a paper gap between two panel rules
draws: A paper-coloured gap separates two vertical panel rules.
params: uv: panel coordinates; x: gutter position

name: lineHoldFrame
doc: hold-frame rule: a 12fps vibrating panel border from hashed offsets
draws: a panel border that trembles on twelve-frame holds, like a hand-held cut.
params: uv: panel coordinate; t: time, border jitter re-rolled on a 12fps hold; inset fixed at 0.02

name: lineImpact
doc: impact ring: a hard shock ellipse, fwidth AA
functions: float lineImpact(vec2 p, vec2 at, float r, float px)
draws: a hard shock ring spreading outward from a point, flattened to the panel shape.
params: p: pixel position; at: ring centre; r: ring radius; px: edge softness in pixels

name: linePanel15
doc: 1.5px panel rule: a constant-pixel frame in indigo
draws: a thin indigo rule framing the whole panel at a constant pixel width.
params: uv: panel coordinate; no other control, inset fixed at 0.012

name: lineSfx
doc: sfx burst: a starburst of short ink ticks, held on twos
functions: float lineSfx(vec2 p, vec2 at, float t)
draws: a starburst of short ink ticks around a hit, re-rolled on twelve-frame holds.
params: p: pixel position; at: burst centre; t: 12fps hold picks 12 to 15 spokes; ring band 0.18 to 0.34 fixed

name: lineSlash
doc: slash: one diagonal cut with AA, a panel action mark
draws: a single diagonal ink cut across the panel, like a blade mark.
params: p: pixel position; px: edge width; direction and span fixed

name: lineSpeedHoriz
doc: horizontal speedlines: motion to the right, thicker near the subject
draws: horizontal speed lines streaming to the right, thickest near the subject.
params: p: pixel position; 40 rows fixed, 35 percent kept by hash, fade-in from x 0.15 to 0.4

name: lineSpeedRadial
doc: radial speedlines from a focus, density falls with radius
functions: float lineSpeedRadial(vec2 p, vec2 at, float n)
draws: radial speed lines fanning out from a focus and thinning toward the edge.
params: p: pixel position; at: focus point; n: spoke count; falloff from r 0.55 to 0.95 fixed

name: lineSpeedVert
doc: vertical speedlines: a drop or rise, not a hatch
draws: vertical speed lines dropping or rising down the frame.
params: p: pixel position; 36 columns fixed, 40 percent kept by hash

name: lineTrail
doc: action trail: smeared afterimages held on twos
functions: vec3 lineTrail(vec3 col, vec2 p, float t)
draws: three afterimage smears trailing behind the subject, each fainter than the last.
params: col: base colour; p: pixel position; t: unused; ghost step 0.04 and strength 0.35 per tap

name: lineVanishing
doc: vanishing-point rays: perspective speed, not radial from centre
draws: thin rays converging on a vanishing point off to one side.
params: p: pixel position; vp: vanishing point; 18 spokes fixed

name: lineZip
doc: zip lines: staggered dashes racing across the frame
draws: staggered dashes racing sideways in rows across the frame.
params: p: pixel position; 22 rows fixed, 6 dash repeats across, row offset per row

name: paperBleed
doc: pigment bleed: chroma seeps a few pixels into the tooth
functions: vec3 paperBleed(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: colour seeping a few pixels into the paper tooth at the darker wet patches.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; strength 0.28 fixed; wet patch threshold 0.35 to 0.7

name: paperCelDust
doc: cel dust: sparse specks on a painted cel, held on twos
functions: vec3 paperCelDust(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: sparse light specks scattered over the painted cel, changing every twelve frames.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; t: 12fps hold reseeds specks; density threshold 0.992 fixed

name: paperCockle
doc: cockle: wet-stretch warp of UVs, pigment follows the buckle
functions: vec3 paperCockle(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: the image rippling softly, as if the sheet had swelled from water.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate, warped by fbm; warp amplitude 0.02 and mix 0.35 fixed

name: paperDeckle
doc: deckle edge: ragged paper rim, AA'd, indigo not black
functions: vec3 paperDeckle(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: a ragged, slightly darkened rim where the paper edge would be.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate on the 1.44 panel; rim inset 0.03 and jitter 0.02 fixed

name: paperFiber
doc: laid fiber: long pulp streaks in one direction
functions: vec3 paperFiber(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: faint long streaks running in one direction through the paper.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; streak direction fixed; multiply range 0.92 to 1.04

name: paperFoxing
doc: foxing: warm brown age spots, sparse, printed not dirty
functions: vec3 paperFoxing(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: small warm brown age spots scattered across the sheet.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; spot threshold 0.72 to 0.88 fixed; tint strength 0.45

name: paperGate
doc: gate weave: a 12fps vertical hold jitter of the whole plate
functions: vec3 paperGate(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: the whole frame jittering vertically by a small amount, twelve times a second.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; t: 12fps hold sets vertical jitter 0.006; cel mix 0.4 fixed

name: paperGrain
doc: paper grain: low-frequency pulp tooth, printed stock not CGI snow
functions: vec3 paperGrain(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: a faint fine tooth of uneven brightness over the whole image.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; two fbm frequencies (11 and 28) and amplitudes 0.08 and 0.03 fixed

name: paperHalation
doc: halation: a warm fringe on the key edge, not bloom, under the luma cap
functions: vec3 paperHalation(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: a warm orange fringe along the bright key-light edges.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; key-edge band 0.68 to 0.78 fixed; warm mix 0.35

name: paperLaid
doc: laid lines: parallel chain lines of handmade stock
functions: vec3 paperLaid(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: faint parallel chain lines, as on handmade stock.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; 22 rows and 4 chain columns per unit fixed; darkening 6 and 4 percent

name: paperMisreg
doc: misregister: cyan and magenta plates offset a hair, print accident
functions: vec3 paperMisreg(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: the red and blue channels slipping a hair out of register, leaving a coloured fringe.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; channel offsets 0.004 and 0.003 fixed; original blend 0.18

name: paperNews
doc: newsprint: grey stock, visible fiber, slight yellowing
functions: vec3 paperNews(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: a greyish newsprint tone with visible fibre and a slight yellowing.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; stock tint vec3(0.78, 0.74, 0.64) fixed; fibre scale 40 by 8

name: paperOffset
doc: offset: CMY plates slightly sheared, a press miss
functions: vec3 paperOffset(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: the green and blue channels shifted toward the luminance, like a press miss.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; y offset 0.003 fixed; mix 0.35 green and 0.2 blue

name: paperPlate
doc: plate wear: worn patches where the ink sits thinner
functions: vec3 paperPlate(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: worn patches where the ink looks thinner.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; wear threshold 0.6 to 0.85; strength 0.5 fixed

name: paperPulp
doc: pulp clumps: soft value masses in the stock, low frequency
functions: vec3 paperPulp(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: soft lumps of slightly darker and lighter pulp across the sheet.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; fbm frequency 4.5 fixed; multiply range 0.94 to 1.03

name: paperShowThru
doc: show-through: a faint reverse plate ghosts from the back of the sheet
functions: vec3 paperShowThru(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: a faint ghost of the reverse side showing through the sheet.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate, mirrored in x about 1.44; strength 0.08 fixed

name: paperSoak
doc: ink soak: darks feather into the fiber, a wet print
functions: vec3 paperSoak(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: dark areas feathering outward into the paper, like a wet print.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; fbm frequency 8 and threshold 0.3 to 0.7; ink mix 0.22 fixed

name: paperTooth
doc: cold-press tooth: pits that catch pigment, not a noise overlay
functions: vec3 paperTooth(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: small pits where the pigment darkens, giving a cold-press texture.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; fbm frequency 14 and threshold 0.55 to 0.82; pit darkening 0.35

name: paperWeave
doc: screen weave over paper: two rotated grids as a printed rosette
functions: vec3 paperWeave(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: a faint printed rosette made of two crossed screen grids.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; grids at 48 per unit rotated plus and minus 30 degrees; darkening 0.22

name: paperWove
doc: wove: a fine even mesh, quieter than laid
functions: vec3 paperWove(vec3 col, vec2 q, float t)
draws: an almost invisible fine, even mesh across the paper.
params: col: base colour; q: coordinate; sine mesh frequency 90 fixed; multiply range 0.97 to 1.02

name: blend
doc: Photoshop blend modes (multiply, screen, overlay, colour dodge/burn, soft light, linear light) and a masked layer() mix
functions: vec3 layer(vec3 base, vec3 blended, float opacity, float mask)
draws: a grey ramp recoloured by a red-to-teal layer under multiply, screen, overlay, dodge, soft light and burn bands.
params: bMultiply/bScreen/bOverlay/bDodge/bBurn/bSoftLight/bLinearLight take (base a, layer b) colours; layer() takes opacity and mask floats to mix the result.

name: blobshadow
doc: soft cast shadows from sphere occluders along the light, for painted ground without a shadow map
draws: soft lavender cast shadows falling from rocks onto grass along the key light.
params: uOcc[48] occluder spheres (xyz centre, w radius in metres); uOccN occluder count; blobShadow(P, L) takes surface point and light direction and returns 0 lit to 1 shadowed.

name: brushgrass
doc: non-repeating painted grass strokes: scattered tapered blades, 3 layers, each with its own size, lean and value
functions: vec3 brushGrass(vec2 p, float size, float ang, float seed)
vec3 grassLayers(vec2 p, float size, float ang)
draws: a field of tapered painted grass blades in three layers of different sizes, drooping and darker at the root.
params: p plate coordinates; size stroke length; ang lean from vertical in radians; seed for brushGrass; grassLayers composes three layers at size, 0.7x and 0.5x.

name: cel
doc: hard-edged toon ramps: n flat tones or a 3-colour cel map with razor shadow edges
functions: vec3 cel3(float v, float t1, float t2, vec3 dark, vec3 mid, vec3 light)
draws: a sphere-like gradient broken into flat toon bands with crisp shadow edges.
params: v input value; n number of flat tones for celSteps; t1, t2 thresholds for cel3; dark, mid, light colours for cel3.

name: flare
doc: anamorphic lens flare: streak, spike, star and hot core, additive
draws: an anamorphic lens flare with a horizontal streak, vertical spike, diagonal star and white-hot core blooming over the frame.
params: q offset from the flare centre in frame-height units; returns additive intensity, values above 1 bloom.

name: glow
doc: local glow lights that wash nearby surfaces through their texture, composited as colour dodge
functions: float glowFall(vec3 P, vec3 N, vec4 G)
vec3 glowDodge(vec3 col, vec3 glowCol, float amount)
draws: a soft coloured light pooling on nearby walls and surfaces, lifting their texture like a lantern in the dark.
params: glowFall: P surface point, N normal, G light (xyz position, w radius); glowDodge: col surface colour, glowCol light colour, amount strength.

name: grade
doc: gradient map by value, luma-weighted film grain, IGN grain and vignette
functions: vec3 gradientMap(vec3 col, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
vec3 filmGrain(vec3 col, vec2 fc, float seed, float amount)
vec3 vignette(vec3 col, vec2 uv, float k)
draws: the whole frame remapped to a shadow-mid-highlight colour ramp with silver film grain and dark corners.
params: gradientMap: a, b, c shadow, mid, light colours; filmGrain: amount strength and seed; ign: seed for dither; vignette: k darkening strength.

name: grunge
doc: multi-scale mottled stain with pits and run-down streaks (concrete, plaster); value multiplier, 2D and 3D
functions: float grunge3(vec3 Q, float contrast, float streak)
float grunge2(vec2 p, float contrast, float streak)
draws: a mottled concrete or plaster stain with pits and run-down streaks across a surface.
params: Q or p scaled position; contrast how strong the blotches are; streak how much the vertical run-downs darken.

name: huegrade
doc: single-hue grade by value with one protected accent hue (MAPPA: crimson-black frame, cyan accent)
functions: float accentMask(vec3 col, float hue, float width)
vec3 hueGrade(vec3 col, vec3 dark, vec3 mid, vec3 light, float amount, float keep)
draws: a whole frame pushed toward one hue by brightness while a single accent hue keeps its colour.
params: accentMask: hue 0..1 and width of the protected hue; hueGrade: dark, mid, light colours, amount strength, keep override for the accent.

name: ink
doc: constant-pixel ink lines on level sets of any 2D field, plain or jagged and tapered
functions: float isoInk(float f, float level, float px)
float jaggedInk(float f, float level, float px, float jag, vec2 p)
draws: constant-width black ink contours tracing where a field crosses a level, optionally broken into tapered jagged clumps.
params: f field value; level contour value; px line width in pixels; jag frequency of the jagged break-up; p position for the noise.

name: kuwahara
doc: painterly edge-preserving smoothing: 4-quadrant and generalized 8-sector Kuwahara on any texture
functions: vec3 kuwahara8(sampler2D t, vec2 uv, vec2 res, float R)
vec3 kuwahara4(sampler2D t, vec2 uv, vec2 res, float R)
draws: a photo or render turned into painterly flat brush dabs that keep hard edges between regions.
params: t source texture; uv position; res texture size; R kernel radius in pixels (4-quadrant up to 6, 8-sector up to 8).

name: lightning
doc: a thin branching bolt between two points: displaced filament plus soft glow, additive
functions: vec3 bolt2(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b, float seed, vec3 col)
draws: a thin jagged electric bolt running from a top point to a strike point, with a branch below the midpoint and a soft glow.
params: a top point; b strike point; seed changes the shape; col colour, scale it to dim.

name: mist
doc: drifting haze with soft edges: a GLSL mist() mask and a 3D mistCard() that keeps the set id
functions: float mist(vec2 uv, float aspect, float seed)
draws: soft drifting haze banks that fade out at the left, right and bottom edges of the frame.
params: uv position; aspect frame width over height; seed; mistCard takes w, h, colour, alpha and seed for a 3D card.

name: noise
doc: 2D value noise, fbm, ridged, warp, Voronoi, brush strokes, ramps and blob SDFs: the base of every painted tool
functions: float strokes(vec2 p, float ang, float len, float wid)
vec3 ramp3(float t, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
vec3 ramp4(float t, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c, vec3 d)
float blob(vec2 p, vec2 c, vec2 r, float rough)
draws: the base textures of every painted tool: fbm clouds, ridged folds, Voronoi cracks and brush strokes.
params: p 2D position; k warp strength; a angle; len and wid stroke size; t gradient position; a, b, c, d ramp colours; rough blob roughness; r blob radius.

name: puffs
doc: cumulus masses as a union of spheres seen from the front: per-pixel normal and coverage for billow shading
draws: cumulus clouds as lit rounded billows seen from the front, with soft edges.
params: uPuff[96] sphere list (xy centre, z radius, w depth); uN count; erode edge breakup amount; puffBanks builds the sphere list from column banks.

name: storm
doc: storm-cloud density, light march, cauliflower billow normals and rim-lit light pockets
functions: float rimBand(vec2 p, float d, vec2 L, float r, float w)
float pocket(vec2 p, vec3 n, vec2 L, float r)
draws: a boiling black storm cloud with light pockets that catch only the rims of billows facing them.
params: uStormScale feature size; uStormAspect stretch; bias coverage shift in stormDensB; L light position; r pocket falloff radius; w rim width.

name: veins
doc: veined smoke: thin branching blood-mist filaments (edges of a twice-warped Voronoi field) with a soft halo and smoke body
functions: vec2 veins(vec2 p, float scale, float warpK, float seed)
draws: thin branching blood-mist filaments drifting through a faint smoke body, with a soft red halo.
params: p position; scale feature size; warpK domain-warp strength; seed. Returns x vein intensity and y smoke body; the caller colours it.

draws: A cool, desaturated print look in which only cyan tones keep their saturation.
params: col: input colour; no tunables. Grey mix 0.26; cyan gate on b-r 0.06..0.20.

name: megiddoShaft
doc: one named pillar: wide film core, deep edge, cave floor contact
draws: One soft cyan pillar of light falls onto the cave floor.
params: p: position; t: sway (0.02*sin t*0.5). Gaussian width 0.04 at x=0.48.

name: occludeInvert
doc: luma-safe invert on the maw only
draws: The inside of a jaw-shaped maw is colour-inverted.
params: p: position; t: unused. Maw ellipse 0.22x0.10 at (0.72,0.48), strength 0.55.

name: occludeSeal
doc: plinth ellipse: cave glue, chubby-pear hole
draws: An elliptical hole in the frame shows the backdrop, with dark glue around it.
params: p: position; t: unused. Ellipse centre (0.72,0.44), radii 0.20x0.26.

name: plinthBronze
doc: 0.85m bronze plinth: written metal, rim #c4a574
draws: A bronze plinth with a rim highlight stands on the cave floor.
params: p: position; t: unused. Box centre (0.72,0.18), half-size 0.16x0.07, rim width 1.8.

name: predatorMaw
doc: stacked tooth SDF: seven up, seven down, cave-pool gum
draws: A row of stacked teeth, seven up and seven down, opens over a dark gum.
params: p: position; t: jaw wobble (t*1). Seven teeth pairs from x=0.46 step 0.08; jaw amplitude 0.08.

name: sealPlaque
doc: SEAL SEAL plaque: bronze card, film letters, 1.2×0.7
draws: A bronze plaque with cyan lettering and a bar stroke across it.
params: p: position; t: unused. Plaque centre (0.72,0.14), bar at y=0.04.

name: slimeLens
doc: water-lens warp: fbm offset, fresnel rim, cave shows through
draws: A rippling water-lens warp around the body with a rim glow, so the cave shows through.
params: p: position; t: drift (t*0.2). Warp 0.045, lens radius 0.20, rim strength 0.50.

name: veldoraScroll
doc: storm-dragon scroll: indigo paper, cyan bolt kana, not a face
draws: A dark indigo scroll with a cyan bolt-shaped line running across it.
params: p: position; t: bolt wave (t). Scroll centre (0.28,0.52), bolt amplitude 0.2.

name: worldHatch
doc: slime film grain: no wool hatch, caustic bands only
draws: Light cyan wavy caustic bands drift across the cave backdrop.
params: p: position; t: drift (t*0.3). Band frequency 10x, strength 0.28.

name: worldPlate
doc: cave-pool: deep #3a6a88, film #6ec8e0, never a classroom
draws: a deep teal cave pool fading to a pale blue film near the surface, with faint light caustic streaks drifting across the water
params: p: plate-space position (vec2); t: time, slowly drifts the noise and caustics

name: loopAuraColumn
draws: A tall column rising from one point: dark magenta outside, brighter magenta inside and a white-pink core, hard-edged, with a jittering outline.
params: uLpAuCx: column axis; uLpAuBase: base height; uLpAuW0 and uLpAuW1: width at the base and at the top; uLpAuTop: column height; uLpAuSpike: extra width fraction at the peak (0.4 at 6.2 s).
doc: three-band flat magenta aura column standing on the seal, widening upward, edge flicker on twos, spike at the peak

name: loopCalmSky
draws: A flat three-band blue sky with one low cloud band, a snow bank and a pale ice arch on the horizon, which steps to a dark plum night.
params: uLpSkDrain: 0 calm day to 1 plum night, quantised to 12 steps; uLpSkExit: 1 draws the snow bank and ice arch (B0 and B9), 0 hides them.
doc: calm blue day plate with a low cloud band, snow bank and ice-loop arch, drained to plum fracture night in 12 stepped drawings

name: loopCastleSky
draws: A pale sky with a tall crimson castle of towers, spires and red windows standing on a cloud, and a tilted ring of magenta shards around it.
params: uLpCsRing: ring rotation in radians (step it on twos); the castle stands left of centre, 0.6 frame-heights wide.
doc: sky-beat plate: pale white-pink sky, drawn crimson castle with lit windows on a cloud band, magenta shard ring around it

name: loopCreditCard
draws: A flat cream card with a thin dark border, a red rule across its top and three dark text lines, dropping in two steps onto a blue sky.
params: uLpCdT0: time the card starts to land; the card sits lower left and appears in 2 drawings (halfway, then landed).
doc: cream credit card with ink border and crimson rule that lands on twos in the lower left of the calm sky

name: loopDemonCircle
draws: A flat magenta magic circle of thin pink rings, a six-point star, twelve diamond spokes and a ring of block glyphs around a pale core, on plum.
params: uLpDcCx, uLpDcCy: centre; uLpDcR: full radius; uLpDcPop: size from the pop table 0.38, 0.68, 0.99, 1.0 (0 hides it); uLpDcSpin: rad/s, stepped at 12 fps; uLpDcHex and uLpDcSpoke: weights (1.0 and 0.4 for the 6-fold launch pad, 0.4 and 1.0 for the 12-fold stack); uLpDcTilt: vertical squash.
doc: Maou Gakuin demon circle: 6 rings, 3-arch band, 6/2 hexagram, 12 diamond spokes, 48-block tick band, white core, 12 fps spin
functions: vec2 lpCircle(vec2 p, float spin, float wh, float ws)

name: loopDestructionEye
draws: One large dark-red eye with two white highlights and a half-closed lid; when lit, a red emblem of nested ovals, curved wings and two small triangles glows in the lens.
params: uLpEyCx, uLpEyCy: eye centre; uLpEyR: lens radius; uLpEyEmblem: 0 calm, 1 emblem lit; uLpEyLid: 0 shut to 1 open, 0.45 calm and 0.7 in power beats (open fraction).
doc: seal eye as Anos: dark red lens, two pale highlights, heavy upper lid, and the red Destruction Eye emblem of 3 nested ovals, 2 wing arcs and 2 triangles

name: loopFissureFloor
draws: A dark red-brown ground seen at a slant with nine jagged cracks running out from the seal, each glowing red with a pink-red hot centre.
params: uLpFlCx, uLpFlCy: crack origin under the seal; uLpFlReach: longest fissure length (grow it on twos from 0); uLpFlSnow: 0 dark floor, 1 snow floor.
doc: dark crimson-brown floor split by 9 jagged radial fissures lit crimson from inside, recolourable to the snow of the loop exit

name: loopFractureSky
draws: A flat dark plum sky broken into cells by thin pale-pink cracks that spread outward cell by cell.
params: uLpFxCrack: 0 to 1 crack growth, quantised to 12 steps; each cell lights after its own delay, and the crack widens with growth.
doc: plum night sky of about 40 Voronoi cells whose edges light up pink as hairline cracks that grow on twos

name: loopGrade
draws: The finished picture with plum shadows, pink-white highlights, nothing brighter than 0.92 or darker than the studio ink, and dark cinema bars top and bottom.
params: uLpGrSplit: split-tone strength (0.35 in power beats f26 to f145, 0 elsewhere); uLpGrBar: bar slide 0 to 1 (full by f11).
doc: Misfit grade: plum and pink-white split tone in power beats, luma cap 0.92, ink-floor lift, 2.39:1 ink letterbox that slides in

name: loopHairSwept
draws: A flat black cap of hair on a pale round head, its lower edge cut into pointed clumps, one long lock swept across the brow, and a single dusky-purple highlight stripe.
params: uLpHrCx, uLpHrCy: head centre; uLpHrR: head radius; the forelock falls to the viewer's left.
doc: Anos hair on the seal: flat black dome with tapered hanging clumps, a swept forelock over the brow, one hard highlight cut

name: loopImpactPlate
draws: A flat full-frame colour with the seal as a single dark shape; in the first version a yellow-green plate, in the second a cream plate with dark ellipse rings around the seal.
params: uLpImCx, uLpImCy: seal centre; uLpImR: seal height; uLpImEyes: 0 dark eyes, 1 red emblem eyes; uLpImNeg: 0 yellow-green plate, 1 cream plate with 4 ink rings.
doc: impact frame as a flat plate: seal as one ink shape with a black fringe, eyes dark or lit red, yellow-green plate (A) or cream plate with ink rings (B)

name: loopJacket
draws: A dark plum-black jacket with a high stand collar edged by a thin crimson line and four plum buttons down the front, in three flat shades.
params: uLpJkCx, uLpJkCy: neck centre; uLpJkR: head-scale radius; jacket lit #2a1d2c, shade x0.86, deep x0.66.
doc: dark academy jacket in three flat bands with a stand collar, thin crimson trim at its top edge and a plum button row

name: loopKit
doc: the-loop helpers: centred frame-unit uv, 12 fps frame clock, seeded hash, ring, segment, box, Magic Eye emblem
functions: float lpSeg(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b)
float lpBox(vec2 q, vec2 c, vec2 h)
float lpTri(vec2 q, float cx, float y0, float w, float hh)
draws: Draws nothing itself; supplies the-loop dock's helpers: centred frame-unit uv, a 12 fps frame clock, a seeded hash, ring, segment and box distances, wing shapes and the Magic Eye emblem.
params: uLpSeed: hash seed; uLpAsp: aspect. Functions lpU, lpFrame, lpH, lpSq, lpSeg, lpRing, lpBox, lpTri, lpWing, lpEmblem.

name: loopShardSphere
draws: A ball made of sixty flat pink-magenta facets with thin pale seams, lit from the upper left, turning in steps.
params: uLpSsCx, uLpSsCy: centre; uLpSsR: radius (2.2 m); uLpSsSpin: rad/s (0.6), stepped at 12 fps.
doc: 60 flat magenta facets gathered into a ball, a thin pale edge between facets, hard two-step lighting, spin on twos

name: loopSpeckColumn
draws: Small flat round dots in magenta, crimson and dark brown rising in a column, thinning toward the top, with a few pale-pink ones.
params: uLpSpCx: column axis; uLpSpBase: start height; uLpSpR: column radius; uLpSpTop: column height; uLpSpRise: rise speed in cells per second (14 m/s is about 168).
doc: about 200 hard 1 to 2 px dots in seven magenta and crimson colours pouring upward in a column, stepped at 12 fps

name: deepAharonovBohm
doc: Aharonov–Bohm: phase winds by flux around a solenoid
draws: a violet-to-teal interference pattern of rings winding around a glowing amber solenoid spot
params: p: plane point; t: slow flux wobble; solenoid fixed at (0.70,0.50); flux 1.35 base, 0.25 swing

name: deepBesselEigen
doc: Laplacian eigenfunction on a disk: J_n(λ r) cos(nθ)
draws: a disk filled with a violet and amber standing-wave pattern, ringed by a dark outline
params: p: plane point; t: rotation speed of the pattern; disk centre (0.72,0.50), radius 0.34; n=3 lobes, lambda 8.65

name: deepBiLaplace
doc: biharmonic point load: fundamental solution r² log r rings
draws: concentric warm and cool ripple rings spreading out from a point load, with thick ink contour lines
params: p: plane point; t: slow pulse of amplitude; load point at (0.70,0.50) drifting

name: deepBrusselator
doc: Brusselator hex spots: activator lattice from cubic kinetics
draws: a hexagonal lattice of glowing mint spots that pulse out of phase
params: p: plane point; t: pulse rate 1.3 and slow scroll; lattice scale (8.2,9.1)

name: deepCBrenierMap
doc: Brenier map ∇φ of a convex potential, warped grid
draws: a square grid bent around a convex bulge, with a warm-to-cool gradient and an amber centre dot
params: p: plane point; t: slow drift of the bulge centre; warp strength -0.24; grid density 5.5

name: deepCharbonnier
doc: Charbonnier regularizer 1/sqrt(1+|∇u|²/ε) as a soft edge plate
draws: a violet-to-mint field that dims along sharp edges, with amber contour rings
params: p: plane point; t: animates the underlying field; epsilon 0.35 sets edge sensitivity
qualityNote: alias: same edge-stopping plate as deepPeronaMalik, with a different falloff curve

name: deepChebyshevAlias
doc: Chebyshev T_n clustered nodes: oscillation packs at the ends
draws: a warm-cool wave train that packs its oscillations tightly toward the left and right edges, with rust stripes
params: p: plane point; t: phase drift; degree n=9; x maps the plate to [-1,1]

name: deepCMCSoap
doc: CMC unduloid: Delaunay soap profile a + b cos(kz)
draws: a soap-film neck profile: a rippling ink outline of a bulging tube that breathes with time
params: p: plane point; t: breathing of amplitude b and phase; base radius a=0.16; wavenumber k=9

name: deepCoherenceEnhance
doc: coherence-enhancing shock: sharpen along the minor eigenvector
draws: an amber-to-cool gradient with dense ink hatching running across the grain of the field, and rust shock lines
params: p: plane point; t: drives the field; hatch pitch 26; shock strength 0.08

name: deepCutLocus
doc: cut locus: shock of min-distance to two moving sources
draws: two drifting amber discs with a sharp rust seam running between them where their distance fields meet
params: p: plane point; t: moves two sources a and b; seam width 1.8

name: deepDipoleField
doc: electric dipole: field lines of (3(p·r)r − p)/r³
draws: a warm-cool dipole with teal field-line contours curling around an amber charge at the centre
params: p: plane point; t: rotates the dipole moment; charge at (0.72,0.50)

name: deepDispersionPacket
doc: dispersive packet ω=k²: chirped envelope, Airy tails
draws: a horizontal wave packet of teal ripples that spreads and chirps as it travels, with amber fringe bands
params: p: plane point; t: packet travel and spread; spread factor 0.35 + 0.12t

name: deepDisplacementInterp
doc: McCann displacement: rays x_t = (1−t)a + t T(a)
draws: nine amber dots sliding between two sets of positions along teal rays, morphing as the loop plays
params: p: plane point; t: interpolation s, 0 to 1; nine sites from dmSite

name: deepEikonalCone
doc: eikonal |∇u|=1 from a source: Euclidean distance cone
draws: concentric teal rings spreading from a drifting source, each ring outlined in ink
params: p: plane point; t: drift of the source at (0.64,0.48); ring pitch 6
qualityNote: alias: same radial rings from one moving point as deepHeatMethod, without the heat-kernel distance

name: deepEnstrophyHatch
doc: enstrophy |ω|² of a vortex pair, hatch along ω contours
draws: two opposite-spin vortex blobs in rust and cool tones, with hatching that thickens where the spin is strongest
params: p: plane point; t: slow sway of the two vortices; spin sign is opposite on each; hatch pitch 22 to 62

name: deepFaradayLoop
doc: Faraday: inductive E_θ = −(r/2) ∂B/∂t concentric loops
draws: concentric violet-to-teal loops that flip brightness as the magnetic field changes, with inked rings and amber core
params: p: plane point; t: drives dB/dt through cos(1.6t); loop spacing 1/8; core radius 0.05

name: deepFitzHughNagumo
doc: FitzHugh–Nagumo pulse: sech²(ξ) activator, lagged recovery w
draws: a single bright amber pulse travelling across the frame with a violet trailing recovery wave
params: p: plane point; t: pulse speed 0.14; width 7.5; nullcline bend 0.22

name: deepFourierBand
doc: band-limited Fourier sum: three modes under a cutoff disk
draws: a mint and cool woven sine texture with a rust circle outline marking the band cutoff
params: p: plane point; t: slow phase of each of the three modes; cutoff radius 0.55 around (0.72,0.50)

name: deepGaborAtom
doc: one Gabor atom: Gaussian window × complex exponential
draws: a single cosine stripe packet, amber and cool, fading out under a teal ring around its centre
params: p: plane point; t: centre drift and stripe phase; window widths 7.5 and 9.0; ring radius 0.18

name: deepGeodesicFan
doc: geodesic polar chart on a conformal warp: rays + distance circles
draws: a warped field of mint-to-cool distance rings with amber rays fanning out from a point
params: p: plane point; t: unused; warp amount 0.12; ray count 5 per half turn

name: deepGrayScott
doc: Gray–Scott spots: activator peaks, inhibitor rings, feed F
draws: mint spots that bloom on a cool field, each ringed in rust like a fading halo
params: p: plane point; t: site drift at rate 0.4; spot sharpness 55; feed weight 0.72

name: deepGreenDisk
doc: Green function of the disk: log |x−y| minus image charge
draws: a disk with a warm-cool potential field inside, a glowing amber charge orbiting and a clean ink rim
params: p: plane point; t: orbit of the charge; disk radius 0.32 at (0.72,0.50)

name: deepHeatKernel
doc: heat kernel k_τ(x,s) = (4πτ)^{-1} exp(-|x-s|²/4τ) isolines
draws: a soft cool-to-amber heat bloom around a breathing source, with inked iso-contours
params: p: plane point; t: source drift and heat time tau 0.045 +/- 0.018

name: deepHeatMethod
doc: Varadhan geodesic: d ≈ sqrt(−4τ log k_τ) from a moving source
draws: concentric teal and paper distance rings radiating from a point that slides left and right
params: p: plane point; t: source drift; heat time tau 0.055; ring pitch 7

name: deepHelmholtzHankel
doc: radiating Helmholtz: J0(k r) circular wave + outgoing phase
draws: a circular wave pattern around a point that breathes in and out, with an amber source dot
params: p: plane point; t: amplitude cos(2.2t); wavenumber k=18; source at (0.68,0.50)

name: deepHopfLax
doc: Hopf–Lax: u(x,t)=inf_y { t L((x−y)/t) + g(y) } over sites
draws: a bowl-shaped amber-to-cool height field with ink contour rings around six low points
params: p: plane point; t: time horizon tau 0.35 to 0.5; six sites from dmSite

name: deepLambOseen
doc: Lamb–Oseen core: ω = (Γ/4πνt) exp(−r²/4νt) decaying swirl
draws: a rust swirl core fading outward, with curved ink hatching following the rotation
params: p: plane point; t: decay time tau; viscosity nu 0.012; circulation implicit in the scale

name: deepLaplaceRelax
doc: Jacobi relax toward a harmonic: residual |Δu| bands fade
draws: a teal harmonic pattern that settles smooth over time, with rust residue fading away
params: p: plane point; t: relaxation time, a = 1 - exp(-0.35t); noise scale 7; mix of modes 0.65 and 0.28

name: deepmathKit
doc: shared deep-P grammar: luma cap 0.92, fwidth AA, indigo ink, heat / modes / curvature helpers
functions: float dmIso(float f, float lvl, float px)
float dmBand(float f, float a, float b)
float dmHeat(vec2 p, vec2 s, float tau)
float dmVaradhan(vec2 p, vec2 s, float tau)
float dmMode(vec2 p, float n, float m)
vec3 dmMix3(float u, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
float dmHatch(vec2 p, vec2 dir, float pitch)
draws: nothing on its own; it supplies the shared palette, anti-aliasing, field and hatch helpers that the other deepmath modules call
params: no uniforms; functions: dmTone and dmPaper for palette, dmIso and dmLine for contours, dmHeat, dmVaradhan, dmGrad, dmLap, dmHatch for fields

name: deepMeanCurvatureFlow
doc: MCF of a circle: r(t)=sqrt(R²−2t) shrinking fronts
draws: a circle of amber and warm rings that shrinks inward over time, each shrink stage traced in ink
params: p: plane point; t: flow time, wraps every 0.055 units; radius^2 0.12 at start

name: deepMeanCurvatureLevel
doc: level-set MCF: speed −H n, 0-level of φ with H stripes
draws: a blobby level-set front that flows inward with rust stripes marking regions of high curvature
params: p: plane point; t: flow time; mean curvature stripes at 1.25; front offset 0.20

name: deepOregonator
doc: Oregonator / BZ spiral: arg − r/λ + ωt involute
draws: a violet and amber spiral arm turning outward from a centre point, like a rotating chemical wave
params: p: plane point; t: rotation speed 1.15; radial twist 7.2; centre (0.70,0.50)

name: deepOsherSethian
doc: Osher–Sethian advection: φ0 transported by a swirl velocity
draws: an amber blob that rotates around a centre while its ink outline is carried along the swirl
params: p: plane point; t: swirl angle 0.55t; blob at (0.86,0.50) radius 0.14

name: deepPeronaMalik
doc: Perona–Malik: g(|∇u|)=1/(1+|∇u|²/K²) edge-stopping ink
draws: a warm-to-cool field where ink lines fade in on the edges and teal hatching shows where the image is smooth
params: p: plane point; t: field time; edge-stopping K 1.8; hatch pitch 18

name: deepPoissonSolve
doc: Poisson Δu = −ρ: free-space log potential of charge lumps
draws: a violet-to-amber potential over five charge lumps, with ink contours marking the levels
params: p: plane point; t: site drift; five charges from dmH21 signs; softening 0.012

name: deepPoyntingHatch
doc: Poynting S = E×B energy-flux hatch of a crossing pair
draws: a cool-to-amber band of crossing wave stripes with hatch lines that follow an energy-flux direction
params: p: plane point; t: phase speed 2.0; stripe frequency 8; hatch pitch 24

name: deepRedistancing
doc: closest-point redistance: Voronoi of the 0-level samples
draws: a mint-to-violet distance field around a ring, with amber rim and hatch rays to the nearest samples
params: p: plane point; t: rotates the 12 sample points; ring radius 0.20 at (0.72,0.50)

name: deepReinitPDE
doc: Sussman reinit: residual |∇φ|−1 as the picture, sign(φ0) bands
draws: a teal and rust field showing how far the gradient strays from 1, with amber bands along the front
params: p: plane point; t: field time; front offset 0.22; band width 0.04

name: deepRicciConformal
doc: Ricci-flow look: conformal factor e^{−2u} from Gaussian K
draws: a soft cool-to-warm wash with a few ink contours and rust rings where the curvature peaks
params: p: plane point; t: breathing amplitude 0.6 + 0.4 sin(0.25t); curvature scale -0.08

name: deepSchnakenberg
doc: Schnakenberg: spots elongate into stripes as the feed rises in x
draws: a field of violet and teal spots that stretch into stripes as it moves across the frame.
params: p: screen position; t: slow drift of the spot sites

name: deepSchrodingerPhase
doc: free-particle phase Re(e^{i(k·x−ωt)}) de Broglie plate
draws: a sheet of diagonal cool-to-mint bands sliding across the frame like a plane wave.
params: k: wavevector (16, 4.5); omega: angular frequency; t: time

name: deepShannonCardinal
doc: Shannon–Whittaker: cardinal sinc train through impulse samples
draws: seven teal-to-amber sine-wiggle bumps in a row, each one a sinc pulse with random sign.
params: sample spacing 0.18 and sinc scale 14 (fixed); amplitude flips every 5 s via hash; t: time

name: deepSignedDistance
doc: signed distance of a two-lobe metaball, isolines of φ
draws: two soft blobs that merge into one shape with a glowing contour band on its edge.
params: a, b: lobe centres and radii (fixed); k: smooth-min blend width 0.10; t: slow lobe drift

name: deepSinkhornKernel
doc: entropic OT: Gibbs kernel exp(−|x−y|²/ε) between two measures
draws: a soft amber glow where four pairs of dots overlap, fading to violet at the edges.
params: eps: entropic width 0.08 with slow wobble; t: time

name: deepStandingMode
doc: Dirichlet rectangle eigenmode sin(nπx/L) sin(mπy)
draws: a rectangular frame with a violet-to-amber standing-wave pattern that pulses in place.
params: n, m: mode numbers 3 and 2; box extents fixed; t: pulse rate 1.6

name: deepStreamFunction
doc: incompressible stream ψ isolines (div-free ink)
draws: teal and warm bands curling around a point, with ink contour lines tracing the flow.
params: shear slope 0.9; wave amplitude 0.16; vortex at (0.86, 0.38); t: drift

name: deepTEMwave
doc: TEM plane wave: E vertical, B into plate, S along k
draws: vertical warm-cool bands crossing the frame with ink hatching that flickers in step.
params: k: spatial frequency 10; phase speed 2.4; hatch density 18 and 32

name: deepTotalVariation
doc: TV / ROF: |∇u| staircasing, soft-threshold isolines
draws: a warm-to-cool surface cut into flat stepped terraces with ink rings at each step.
params: levels 5 (quantisation); threshold wobble 0.15; t: time

name: deepTuringStripes
doc: Turing wavelength: selected k from linear stability, stripe plate
draws: a teal and warm stripe pattern with a slow change of direction, like animal markings.
params: k: wavenumber 14.5; direction tilt 0.15; cross-mode weight 0.28

name: deepTwoSlit
doc: two-slit |e^{ikr1}+e^{ikr2}|² fringes from a pair of slits
draws: bright and dark fringes fanning out from two rust-red slit dots.
params: slit positions (0.28, 0.38) and (0.28, 0.62); k: wavenumber 22 with slow wobble

name: deepViscosityShock
doc: viscous Burgers shock: u = tanh((x−st)/(2ν)) front
draws: a sharp warm-to-cool front sweeping across the frame with a rust contour on the edge.
params: nu: viscosity 0.035 (front width); st: front speed 0.12; band width 0.18

name: deepVortexSheet
doc: Kelvin–Helmholtz roll-up: tanh shear + cat's-eye stream
draws: a shear line that rolls up into curling eddies with ink contours wrapping each one.
params: k: perturbation wavenumber 6.8; A: amplitude 0.06 with wobble; t: roll-up speed

name: deepVorticityInk
doc: point-vortex stream ψ = Γ log r, ink along streamlines
draws: a warm amber core with ink streaks spiralling around it like a whirlpool.
params: s: vortex centre (0.70, 0.50); Gamma: strength 0.18; hatch density 28; t: streamline drift

name: deepWassersteinGeodesic
doc: W2 geodesic of Gaussians: lerp means, geo of covariances
draws: a warm glow that swells and shrinks as it slides between two teal-marked points.
params: sigma: 0.09 to 0.16 along the path; means m0, m1 fixed; t: 0.28 interpolation rate

name: deepWaveDAlembert
doc: d'Alembert f(x−ct)+g(x+ct) as a traveling plate
draws: two wave trains moving in opposite directions across the frame, with teal contour bands.
params: c: wave speed 1.15 (sets xi and eta); amplitudes 0.55 and 0.35; band rows at y 0.42 and 0.62

name: deepWavefrontCusp
doc: fold caustic: Airy-like cusp of a curved wavefront
draws: a curved bright fold of light with a pointed cusp, the shape of a caustic edge.
params: q scale (1.15, 1.35); cusp centre (0.72, 0.50); sway 0.08; t: slow sway

name: deepWaveletPacket
doc: Morlet packets at three scales: Re(e^{ikx} e^{−x²}) tiling
draws: three Gabor-like ripple packets at different scales sitting side by side on a violet-teal ground.
params: scales 1, 2, 4; centres spaced 0.36 apart; k: 6.0; t: phase speed 0.8
