doc: Ragged tear field: 2-octave edge, no paper fill
draws: A dark ink field split by a rough diagonal edge, like a torn sheet with no paper behind it.
params: p: position; edge direction fixed; fbm wobble 0.12; ink line width 1.8.

name: tickTock
doc: TICK/TOCK: citrus words, alternating lean
draws: A citrus block word that leans left or right depending on which half of the frame it sits in.
params: p: position; side switch at x 0.72; lean plus or minus 0.12; outline width 1.6.

name: traumaShake
doc: Trauma: sheared value, complementary flash
draws: A magenta gradient jolting sideways in thin rows, with a faint colour-inverted flash.
params: p: position; row jitter 0.04 over 40 rows; invert mix 0.18.

name: tsBanana
doc: Banana easter egg: curved tube cel
draws: A yellow curved banana tube with three cel bands on a blue field.
params: p: position; centre (0.72, 0.42); curve 0.08; tube radius 0.02 to 0.06.

name: tsClockPolar
doc: Polar-saw clock ticks
draws: A clock face with twelve citrus saw ticks inside a dark ink rim.
params: p: position; face scale 1.7; tick count 12; rim radius 1.0.

name: tsComplement
doc: 2-frame complement flash on shot cut
draws: A yellow-to-violet split frame with alternate horizontal bands turned to their negative.
params: p: position; band frequency 2 per unit; band threshold 0.35.

name: tsDepthGlue
doc: Depth-glued mask: screen ellipse, seal hole
draws: A cream frame with a vertical elliptical window where the violet inverts, like a hole cut for the seal.
params: p: position; ellipse radii 0.16 by 0.28; edge softness 0.85 to 1.35.

name: tsDroplet
doc: Hanging bead: 2-tone diagonal cut, ink ring
draws: A hanging water bead, blue split on the diagonal, with a white highlight and an ink ring.
params: p: position; bead centre (0.72, 0.55); scale 3.2; highlight offset (-0.38, 0.38).

name: tsFreeze
doc: Freeze grain: mid-weighted, locked
draws: A flat lilac frame with pixel grain, heaviest in the mid tones.
params: p and gl_FragCoord: grain; amount 0.12; two-scale hash mix 0.7 and 0.3.

name: tsHold
doc: Locked frame: hard palette, no drift
draws: A peach-to-orange frame blended with teal along the bottom, in hard locked colours.
params: p: position; x blend split at 0.5; y blend split at 0.55.

name: tsInvert
doc: Invert: 1.0-rgb then luma clamp 0.92
draws: A violet-to-citrus noise wash flipped to its negative.
params: p: position; fbm scale 3; magenta mix 0.4.

name: tsResume
doc: Unfreeze fall: y -= 4.9 age^2 streaks
draws: Blue horizontal streaks that fall and fade from left to right.
params: p: position; fall offset 0.35 times age squared; stripe frequency 10; fade with age.

name: tsSprayHang
doc: Frozen spray cloud: hashed beads, zero gravity
draws: A frozen cloud of cyan and cream beads, each hanging still in the air.
params: p: position; grid 18 per unit; bead chance 0.55 from hash; bead radius 0.18.

name: tsTick
doc: Tick flash: citrus burst at 12
draws: A single citrus flash bursting near the top middle and fading fast.
params: p: position; flash centre (0.72, 0.82); falloff 40; strength 0.9.

name: tsTint
doc: Multiply wash: mix(white, hue, 0.55)
draws: The whole frame washed in lilac on one side and mint on the other.
params: p: position; hue switch at x 0.5; hue mix 0.55; fixed multiplier.

name: wipeBar
doc: Wipe bar: gold slab, ink head edge
draws: A gold slab sliding across the frame with a dark ink leading edge.
params: p: position; slab start 0.33 and width 0.22; edge anti-alias 0.93 to 0.985.

name: worldAfterimage
doc: Ghost afterimage lean to panel violet
draws: A ghosted violet oval standing behind the figure.
params: p: position; ellipse radii 0.12 by 0.22; violet mix 0.55; opacity 0.7.

name: worldBelt
doc: Gold belt + panel studs
draws: A gold belt across the middle of the frame with a row of square studs.
params: p: position; belt y 0.40 and thickness 0.035; stud spacing 10 per unit.

name: worldEye
doc: Stand eye: gold iris, umber lid
draws: A stand's eye with a gold iris, a dark pupil and a heavy umber lid.
params: p: position; eye centre (0.72, 0.62); iris radius 0.035; lid ellipse 0.10 by 0.05.

name: worldFist
doc: Knuckle box + 4 circles, stripe shade
draws: A clenched cream fist with four knuckle dots and diagonal stripe shading.
params: p: position; knuckle spacing 0.06; box 0.14 by 0.10; stripe frequency 8.

name: worldHold
doc: Time-stop hold light: locked key
draws: A warm cel-shaded frame with an inverted tint, like the locked light of a stopped moment.
params: p: position; cel shift from jCut; invert mix 0.22.

name: worldHood
doc: Hood shade: umber cave, hard lip
draws: A dark umber hood shape with a hard lip above a shadowed face.
params: p: position; hood centre (0.72, 0.68); lip ellipse 0.16 by 0.12; shadow band 0.34 to 0.58.

name: worldLimb
doc: Grey-green limb cel, brown seam
draws: A grey-green limb in flat cel tones with a wavy brown seam along its edge.
params: p: position; limb centre x 0.72, half-width 0.08; seam wobble 0.02 at 18 per unit.

name: worldMetal
doc: Anisotropic metallic: stretched spec
draws: A brushed gold surface with thin bright streaks crossing it.
params: p: position; streak frequency 28; specular power 8; gold specular colour.

name: worldPlate
doc: The World plates: cream metallic 3-step
draws: A cream metallic plate with three hard tone steps.
params: p: position; light tilt 0.35 on y, cut 0.25; cel thresholds 0.40 and 0.68; emit 0.4. Same function name as 16 cut-local copies.

name: worldReach
doc: Forearm trail: taper cylinder behind fist
draws: A tapering grey-green forearm trailing back from the fist.
params: p: position; arm from (0.40, 0.48) to (0.88, 0.55); radius 0.07 narrowing to 0.035.

name: worldSeam
doc: Gold band seam, wavelength grade
draws: A thin gold band across the frame with a wavelength-based shimmer.
params: p: position; band y 0.52, half-width 0.025; gold grade.

name: worldSpark
doc: 4-point astroid spark + ink ring
draws: A four-point gold star with a white core and a thin ink ring around it.
params: p: position; scale 2.4; star sharpness 1.0; ring radius 0.62.

name: zaWarudo
doc: ZA WARUDO: cream bar on invert hold
draws: A cream lettering bar with an ink outline on an inverted purple ground, the flat card for a time-stop title.
params: p: plane coords; bar centred at (0.72, 0.62), half size 0.38 by 0.07. No text glyphs.

name: mhArmySky
draws: A sky of six flat horizontal bands from dusty rose at the top to dark brown-red at the horizon, broken by long thin darker cloud bars.
params: uMhArmyLift: brightens every band; uMhArmyBars: how many cloud bars cut the bands (0 clear, 1 heavy).
doc: Army-red dusk strata: six hard steps from rose to oxblood-brown with horizontal cloud bars cut as value drops, no gradient.

name: mhCel2
draws: A blue-grey sphere split by one hard terminator into a lit coat and a cool violet-tinged shade, no mid tone.
params: uMhCel2Tau: N.L threshold of the terminator; uMhCel2Shift: how far the shade slides toward cold violet (0 = plain darken).
doc: Death Note two-tone cel: one authored threshold, shade hue-shifted cold toward the fill colour, never a gradient.

name: mhCelGold
draws: A violet-robed sphere in three flat tones with a thin crisp gold crescent hugging the edge that faces the light behind it.
params: uMhGoldT1/uMhGoldT2: N.L thresholds of the two shade steps; uMhGoldRim: width of the gold crescent (0 = none).
doc: Overlord cel: coat, shade and a deep shade in three flat steps, plus one hard gold rim band on the throne side.
functions: vec3 mhCelGoldRamp(float nl, float rim, vec3 coat)

name: mhEyeRing
draws: A large round eye with a thick amber ring around a dark lens, a tiny pupil dot, one cream catchlight and a flat lid line across the top.
params: uMhEyeRing: ring colour (amber by default, red at the kill); uMhEyeOpen: lid opening 0 closed to 1 open; uMhEyeLens: lens radius.
doc: Madhouse eye: pale sclera, dark lens inside a hard ring 1.4x the lens, a dot pupil, one catchlight, a hard upper lid.

name: mhFlagstone
draws: A receding floor of running-bond stone slabs, every slab one flat blue-violet or grey-violet tone, joined by darker seams instead of drawn lines, fading to dark at the horizon.
params: uMhStoneHorizon: screen height of the horizon; uMhStoneSeam: seam width in stone fractions; uMhStoneLit/uMhStoneShade: the two stone tones.
doc: Unlined painted flagstone: running-bond courses in perspective, each stone one flat tone, seams only as value drops.

name: mhFurNotch
draws: A pale-blue seal-coat sphere whose shadow edge is a row of small hard teeth, with a cooler dorsal shade below it.
params: uMhFurTeeth: teeth across the sphere; uMhFurDepth: how far each tooth bites into the lit side (N.L units).
doc: Seal fur shade: the cel terminator is cut into short saw teeth so the shade edge reads as fur, not as a plastic split.
functions: float mhFurNl(float nl, vec2 q, vec2 ldir)

name: mhGradeInk
draws: The whole frame tinted blue-violet in the shadows and grey-lilac in the lights, with fine grain that jumps twelve times a second and no pure black or blown white.
params: uMhGradeLo/uMhGradeHi: shadow and highlight tints; uMhGradeMix: tint strength; uMhGradeGrain: grain amplitude.
doc: Madhouse final grade: cold split tone weighted by luma, silver grain stepped on twos, then the 0.92 cap and the ink-floor lift.
functions: vec3 mhGrade(vec3 c, vec2 p, float t)

name: mhInkHull
draws: A pale disc rimmed by a hard dark line that swells from a hairline at the lit edge to a heavy stroke on the shadow edge.
params: uMhInkThin/uMhInkThick: line width in pixels at the lit and shadow edge; uMhInkScale: frame height over 800.
doc: Madhouse variable ink line: thin on the lit side, thick on the shadow side, drawn inside the silhouette in warm ink.

name: mhIris
draws: The picture opening from a small round hole into the full frame, held by thick ink bars top and bottom, with a thin ring at the iris edge.
params: uMhIrisAt: iris centre; uMhIrisK: opening progress 0 closed to 1 open (stepped to 11 drawings); uMhIrisBars: bar height as a fraction of frame height.
doc: Madhouse TV iris: a circle that opens from a point in twos, a 3 px ink ring at its edge, and the 2.39:1 letterbox bars in studio ink.

name: mhKit
draws: nothing on screen by itself; it supplies the Madhouse ink colour, luma cap, hard-edge fills, seeded noise and a sphere N.L helper
params: uMhSeed: integer-valued seed that shifts every hash and noise
doc: Madhouse shared law: ink #0a0e0c floor, 0.92 luma cap, hard fills, seeded hash and fbm; every mh shader needs it
functions: float mhNdL(vec2 p, vec2 c, float r, vec3 L)

name: mhRainCone
draws: Pale thin diagonal streaks falling through one lit oval and flat splash rings on its floor, with no rain at all in the surrounding dark.
params: uMhRainC/uMhRainR: cone centre and radii; uMhRainFall: fall speed of the middle layer; uMhRainCol: streak colour.
doc: Rain that exists only inside the light: three depth layers of thin streaks and splash rings, stepped on twos, dark outside the cone.
functions: float mhRainLayer(vec2 p, float t, float cols, float speed, float k)

name: mhSpotPool
draws: A near-black rooftop with one cold cream elliptical pool of light in three flat steps and a few hard-edged darker puddles inside it.
params: uMhSpotC: pool centre; uMhSpotR: pool radii (x, y); uMhSpotAmb: ambient floor 0..0.2; uMhSpotCol: key colour.
doc: Tenebrist cone spot on wet concrete: one cold cream pool in three hard steps over an ambient floor, puddles as flat dark patches.

name: mhWashSky
draws: A pale blue-to-cream sky in five stepped washes, each seam wobbling with a thin darker wet edge, with a few pale pigment blooms.
params: uMhWashTop/uMhWashLow: colour at the zenith and the horizon; uMhWashBleed: how far each wash edge wanders; uMhWashGrain: granulation strength.
doc: Frieren watercolour sky: five stepped washes whose edges bleed with a darker wet rim, pigment blooms and paper granulation.

name: mappaBloomBands
draws: Two warm lights on a cool dark plate, each wrapped in four flat rings of light that step down to nothing, the nearer one pulsing on twos.
params: uMpBloomSigma: halo radius; uMpBloomI: emitter intensity; uMpBloomBands: number of steps in the halo
doc: glow that exists only round emitters, quantised into hard concentric steps with a small hot core
functions: vec3 mpBloom(vec3 base, vec2 p, vec2 e, float sigma, vec3 col, float I, float bands)

name: mappaCel2
draws: A seal-grey sphere cut by one hard shadow edge, a paler belly cut by a second edge, shade tinted cool blue.
params: uMpCelR: sphere radius; uMpCelCutA/uMpCelKA: back cut level and shade multiplier; uMpCelCutB/uMpCelKB: belly cut level and shade multiplier
doc: two-tone cel with one hard cut per material and a cool hue-shifted shade
functions: vec3 mpCel2(vec3 lit, float nl, float cut, float k)

name: mappaEraseBand
draws: A dark rectangular channel cut through a ringed blue plate, hard violet lines along its top and bottom edges and a stepped violet glow that fades over about a second.
params: uMpErY0/uMpErY1: band bottom and top in frame heights; uMpErX: where the band starts (it runs to the left edge); uMpErT0: second the band appears (demo loops every 3 s)
doc: a straight band of the plate snaps to ink from a point to the frame edge, violet light along its edges dying out
functions: vec3 mpErase(vec3 base, vec2 p, float t, float y0, float y1, float xm, float t0)

name: mappaEyeHalfLid
draws: A calm half-closed eye in grey skin: heavy dark lid line, flat shadow band above it, flat sky-blue iris, one white dot, a blink every few seconds.
params: uMpEyeW: eye half-width; uMpEyeOpen: lid opening 0 shut to 1 wide; uMpEyeIris: iris radius in eye half-widths; uMpEyeSide: -1 catchlight left, +1 right
doc: half-lidded almond eye with a brow-shelf shadow, flat pale iris and one catchlight on the light side
functions: vec3 mpEye(vec2 q, vec3 skin, float open, float side, float ir)

name: mappaFurScratch
draws: Two dozen short pale tapered scratches lying along the upper half of a dark grey body.
params: uMpFurCell: grid cells per frame height; uMpFurLen: stroke half-length in cells; uMpFurDens: share of cells carrying a stroke
doc: short hard fur strokes scattered on a grid, light on the dark back only
functions: float mpFur(vec2 p, float cell, float len, float dens)

name: mappaHoleSky
draws: A black disc with a hairline pale rim, three flat blue-grey bands of field around it, thin pale spiral wisps and a stepped glow.
params: uMpHoleX/uMpHoleY: disc centre in frame heights; uMpHoleR: disc radius; uMpHoleRimPx: rim width in pixels
doc: ink disc with a thin hot rim over a cool banded cloud field with log-spiral filaments
functions: vec3 mpHole(vec2 p, vec2 c, float R, float rimPx, float t)

name: mappaInkLine
draws: A thin dark ink outline round a grey blob, thicker in some stretches and thinner in others.
params: uMpInkPx: mean width in screen pixels; uMpInkVary: how far the width wanders (1.1 gives a width CV near 0.45)
doc: thin contour whose width wanders along the outline, ink never black
functions: float mpInkLine(float d, float ang, float px, float vary)

name: mappaKit
draws: Nothing by itself: the shared palette and helpers of the MAPPA look.
params: uMpSeed: integer-valued seed that re-rolls every hash and noise
doc: MAPPA digital-TV kit: cool desaturated palette, hard-band helpers, twos clock, hue-shifted shade; every mappa shader needs it

name: mappaOrbBlue
draws: A small black ball with a hairline light-blue edge, wrapped in four flat bands of electric blue that fade outward.
params: uMpOrbR: core radius; uMpOrbSigma: ring reach; uMpOrbI: intensity, 0 hides the orb
doc: black-hole orb: ink core, thin pale-blue rim and a stepped blue ring
functions: vec3 mpOrbBlue(vec3 base, vec2 p, vec2 c, float r, float sigma, float I)

name: mappaRedCore
draws: A small solid red ball with a flat red halo and five hairline red strands reaching out of it, pale at their tips, drifting on twos.
params: uMpRedR: core radius; uMpRedI: intensity, 0 hides it; uMpRedReach: tendril length in core radii
doc: hot red core with a stepped glow and five thin tapering tendrils tipped pale pink
functions: vec3 mpRedCore(vec3 base, vec2 p, vec2 c, float r, float I, float reach, float th)

name: mappaSpeckInfinity
draws: Small pale specks drawn inward along radial lanes, vanishing at a ring round the hero where a ragged row of stopped specks sits.
params: uMpSpkX/uMpSpkY: sink centre; uMpShX/uMpShY/uMpShR: shell centre and radius; uMpHalt: 0 hides the piled ring, 1 shows it; uMpFlowStop: second at which the flow clock freezes; uMpDim: speck brightness
doc: dust specks streaming into a point on a twos clock, stopped and piled on a ragged shell round a figure
functions: float mpSpecks(vec2 p, vec2 c, float th)
float mpShellPile(vec2 p, vec2 s, float R)

name: mappaSplitFinish
draws: The frame gets blue-tinted shadows, pale highlights, greyer dark areas except strongly saturated reds which stay vivid, nothing pure black or brighter than 0.92; the lower half of the demo is finished, the upper half is raw.
params: uMpFinTone: strength of the split tint 0 to 1; uMpFinDarkSat: colour kept in the darks 0 to 1
doc: final finish: cool shadow and pale highlight tint, desaturated darks that spare a saturated accent, luma cap and ink floor
functions: vec3 mpFinish(vec3 c, float tone, float darkSat)

name: mappaTwosGrain
draws: Fine pixel grain that boils on twos over a dark ramp, strongest in the shadows; the upper half of the demo is clean, the lower half grained.
params: uMpGrainAmt: grain amplitude; uMpGrainRes: grain cells per frame height
doc: film grain re-rolled twelve times a second, heavier in the darks and absent in the ink floor
functions: vec3 mpGrain(vec3 c, vec2 p, float t, float amt, float res)

name: mappaVeinSky
draws: A flat teal sky with hairline red cracks, thick at the left and right edges and thin in the middle, each crack with a dim halo and a hot core.
params: uMpVeinGrow: 0 no veins to 1 fully grown; uMpVeinScale: noise scale of the vein net; uMpVeinDrift: drift speed in frame widths per second
doc: teal banded sky cracked by thin ridged red veins that grow from the frame edges inward
functions: float mpVein(vec2 p, float scale, float drift, float th)

name: mythAshFall
doc: gravity-offset hash flakes — y += 0.5*age^2, not rising embers
draws: Grey-brown ash flakes fall down the frame in three layers that speed up as they drop.
params: t: fall timing per layer (age); flake grid density fixed at 10, 14, 18 cells

name: mythBlackFlame
doc: vertically stretched flame SDF, 3-step cel — not warped soot
draws: A tall black flame with a red-ember rim flickers at the lower right, cut into three hard tone steps.
params: p: flame centred at a fixed point; t: sideways flicker and noise crawl; fbm sets the flame radius

name: mythBladeTriskel
doc: three cubic-arc blades unioned as a triskelion — abstract, not a copyrighted star
draws: Three curved seal-red blades spin around a black hub on indigo.
params: t: spin rate (0.18); blade shapes and hub size fixed in code

name: mythBloodHalo
doc: moon disc plus corona rings (radial isolines), not a lone disc
draws: A pale moon disc sits in a red-indigo night with three thin red corona rings around it.
params: t: night drift only; moon radius 0.12 and ring radii 0.18, 0.26, 0.36 fixed

name: mythCaveEcho
doc: nested arch SDFs receding — depth stacks, not a single mouth
draws: Five dark arch outlines recede into a cave, each darker and smaller than the last.
params: p: arch offset; t unused (static); arch count 5 and step 0.14 fixed

name: mythCaveIndigo
doc: indigo depth gradient plus hanging stalactites — 1D noise icicles
draws: A deep indigo cave gradient with hanging stalactite spikes along the top and a faint torch glow to the right.
params: p: depth gradient from y; icicle heights from a per-column hash; t unused

name: mythCinderRing
doc: expanding polar ember ring with soot interior — annulus, not a field
draws: An ember-coloured ring grows outward from the centre over a sooty dark interior.
params: t: ring radius growth (fract of t*0.18); fbm noise adds wobble and mottling

name: mythCloudRepeat
doc: tiled cloud motif on a stamp grid — lattice, not a free stamp
draws: A grid of red cloud stamps tiled across cream paper, with some cells left empty.
params: t: slow horizontal drift (0.03); cell 0.42 x 0.28 and keep threshold 0.28 fixed

name: mythCloudRim
doc: stroke-only cloud outlines — rim, not a filled stencil
draws: Red outlined cloud shapes float over a dim indigo field, stroke only, with no fill.
params: t: vertical bob of four outlines; stroke width 1.8 px fixed

name: mythCloudScroll
doc: scrolling cloud parade — translate-x march, not a static tile
draws: A row of red clouds slides sideways across an indigo-to-red sky in a loop.
params: t: scroll speed (0.08); row heights from a hash; loop width 1.55 fixed

name: mythCloudStencil
doc: boolean cloud SDF stamps on paper — cut-out, not pigment
draws: Five red cloud cut-outs sit on cream paper and drift slightly, like stamps.
params: t: small drift of five stamp positions; stamp size fixed

name: mythCrowAfterimage
doc: same flock with two trail offsets — smear, not a static hash
draws: Dark crow silhouettes in a flock, each with two faded copies trailing behind it.
params: p: trail offsets (-0.035, 0.012) per step; t unused; fade 0.32 per step

name: mythCrowFlock
doc: hashed chevron silhouettes — flock field, not a trail
draws: Hashed dark crow silhouettes are scattered over a night field, each in a fixed place.
params: p: grid density 9; keep threshold 0.58; t only moves the night plate

name: mythCrowOrbit
doc: crows on circular paths — orbit, not a hashed field
draws: Nine crows circle a small red centre dot on orbit paths of different radius.
params: t: orbit speed (0.4 + 0.05 per group); radius 0.12 to 0.28 fixed

name: mythCycleTick
doc: polar clock ticks plus a rotating hand — discrete cycle, not a smear
draws: A clock face of red tick marks with a cinnabar hour hand that jumps in six steps a second.
params: t: hand steps via myHold at 6 fps; 12 ticks fixed

name: mythDejaVuSmear
doc: spatial stand-in for temporal smear: three offset samples of a seal plate
draws: A cinnabar noise plate shows three offset copies blended together, like a held afterimage.
params: t: held at 8 fps; offsets (0.014, -0.007) and (-0.009, 0.011) fixed; blend 0.42 and 0.28

name: mythEmberHash
doc: cell-hashed rising sparks — power-law mag, not a flame body
draws: Sparks rise through a cell grid: most are tiny, a few glow as bright ember discs.
params: t: rise speed 0.22; magnitude exponent 5.5 sets the size skew; cell density 16 fixed

name: mythFateKnot
doc: trefoil / Lissajous tube — parametric knot, not concentric echoes
draws: A seal-red trefoil knot tube turns slowly against a dark indigo field.
params: t: rotation speed (0.12); 48 sample points and tube radius 0.045 fixed

name: mythFeatherHash
doc: hashed teardrop feathers — down, not a bird silhouette
draws: Scattered teardrop feathers in black and red drift diagonally across a dark grid.
params: t: drift (0.05, -0.12); keep threshold 0.55; density 11 fixed

name: mythFocusLock
doc: crosshair plus ring lock — orthogonal bars, not concentric-only
draws: A crosshair of red bars crosses a cinnabar ring, with a dark dot at the centre.
params: p: centre at MY_C; t unused; bar length 0.28 and ring radius 0.22 fixed

name: mythFocusRing
doc: concentric focus rings with 1/r falloff — lock-on, not a ripple
draws: Concentric red rings fade outward from a dark centre dot, like a lock-on target.
params: p: centre; t unused; ring radii 0.08 to 0.38 and 1/r fade (0.18) fixed

name: mythFuinCircle
doc: seal circle plus radial bars plus center disc — fuin, not a strip
draws: A red seal circle with eight radial bars and a dark central disc sits on paper.
params: p: centre; t unused; 8 bars and band radii 0.10 to 0.28 fixed

name: mythGenjutsuRipple
doc: radial sine ripples sin(r*k - t) — wave, not a static ring
draws: Thin red crests of sine waves ripple outward from the centre over an indigo field.
params: t: wave speed (4.0); k = 28 fixed; crest threshold 0.72

name: mythHollowMouth
doc: cave mouth ellipse with a noisy lip — aperture, not teeth
draws: An elliptical dark cave mouth with a jagged red-black lip, seen through rock.
params: p: mouth centre (0.72, 0.42); t unused; lip noise amplitude 0.10 fixed

name: mythHypnoSpiral
doc: Archimedean spiral r = a + b*theta — one arm, not ripples
draws: A single red Archimedean spiral arm turns around the centre on a dark ground.
params: t: spin (0.8); spiral spacing 0.045 and wrap 0.09 fixed

name: mythInvertNight
doc: invert-then-remap night plate so luma stays ≤ 0.92
draws: The night plate is inverted to pale colours, with a red disc at the centre.
params: t: passed to the night plate only; disc radius 0.14 fixed

name: mythIrisGate
doc: iris aperture shutter: angular leaves closing — wipe, not a spiral
draws: A camera-iris wipe: eight angular leaves open and close over the night plate.
params: t: opening rate (0.9); open range 0.12 to 0.40 fixed; 8 leaves

name: mythIrisRings
doc: concentric iris rings with tomoe ticks on one annulus
draws: Four thin concentric red rings over a dark field, with a band of tick marks on one ring.
params: p: centre; t: tick rotation (0.2); ring radii 0.10 to 0.34 fixed

name: mythIzanamiLoop
doc: Möbius ribbon: theta identifies with a half-period v-flip
draws: A ribbon flips across itself at a half turn, red and indigo, forming a closed loop.
params: t: loop drift (0.04); flip at half period; band 0.32 to 0.68 fixed

name: mythKaleid12
doc: 12-fold kaleidoscope with ink fold-seams (fold + line, not pinwheel)
draws: A twelve-fold mirrored pattern with ink seams between folds, shaded red and black.
params: p: centre; t: slow noise drift (0.1); fold count 12 fixed

name: mythKaleid6
doc: 6-fold polar domain fold: soot wedge mirrored, not a saw blade
draws: A six-fold mirrored soot pattern inside a round red-edged disc.
params: p: centre; t: warp drift (0.08); fold 6 fixed; disc radius 0.38

name: mythKit
doc: shared occult show: cinnabar/indigo ink, red-black-seal, fwidth AA, luma cap 0.92, tomoe/cloud/crow operators
functions: float myBand(float v, float a, float b)
float mySeg(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b)
float myRing(float r, float r0, float hw)
float myArch(vec2 p, float w, float h)
vec3 myMix3(float u, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
draws: Nothing on its own; it is the shared kit of colour, noise and shape operators that the other myth modules call.
params: no uniforms; functions only: luma cap 0.92, fbm, ridge, polar, fold, SDF shapes, paper and night plates

name: mythLoopEcho
doc: concentric phase rings sin(r - t) — echo, not a Möbius twist
draws: Concentric red rings in four hard bands pulse outward from a centre.
params: t: outward phase (3.2); 22 rings per unit; 4 cel bands fixed

name: mythLunarPhase
doc: crescent via two-disc boolean subtract — phase, not a halo
draws: A moon crescent in pale and red, cut out by a second disc that sways slightly.
params: t: crescent offset (0.10 sin); disc radii 0.18 and 0.17 fixed

name: mythMawTeeth
doc: radial triangles around a dark hole — dentition, not a smooth lip
draws: Red triangular teeth ring a dark hole in a radial circle that turns slowly.
params: p: centre (0.72, 0.44); t: rotation (0.05); 14 teeth fixed

name: mythMurderPass
doc: shear-translated flock crossing the frame — pass, not an orbit
draws: A sheared flock of dark crows crosses the frame from left to right, then starts again.
params: t: pass speed (0.22); shear 0.12; grid density 7 fixed

name: mythNightLattice
doc: inverted hexagonal lattice over a moon field — grid, not bands
draws: An inverted hexagonal grid lies over the moon, with the grid lines drawn dark.
params: t: lattice drift (0.08); scale 7; moon radius 0.15 fixed

name: mythOfudaRain
doc: falling ofuda card quads — gravity parade, not a static strip
draws: Seven paper talisman cards with red seals fall and tilt down the frame.
params: t: fall rate (0.15); 7 cards; tilt 0.18 rad fixed

name: mythOfudaStrip
doc: vertical talisman strips with red seal squares — cards, not glyphs
draws: Five upright paper talisman strips stand in a row, each with a red seal square and an ink bar.
params: t: small sway per strip (0.4); strip width 0.07 fixed

name: mythPinwheel3
doc: 3-blade polar saw: rotating pinwheel, cinnabar on indigo
draws: A three-blade pinwheel in cinnabar and red turns on an indigo disc.
params: p: centre; t: rotation (0.55); 3 blades, disc radius 0.34 fixed

name: mythPinwheel6
doc: 6-blade pinwheel: alternating seal/cinnabar plates, ink seams
draws: a six-blade pinwheel of alternating seal-grey and cinnabar plates turning inside a disc, with ink seams between the blades.
params: p: screen position relative to MY_C; t: time, rotates the blades; blade count fixed at 6, seam width fixed at 0.055.

name: mythRedCloudPaper
doc: paper fiber plus red cloud pigment wash — dye, not a boolean stamp
draws: paper fibre washed with red cloud pigment, darkest where the dye pools.
params: p: screen position; t: slow drift of the warp field; dye threshold fixed at 0.42 to 0.78 with 0.82 seal and 0.28 cinnabar mix.

name: mythRedSkyBands
doc: posterized horizontal sky bands — value steps, not a disc
draws: a red sky split into a few posterised horizontal bands that wave gently.
params: p: vertical position drives the band index; t: wave speed of the band edges; 5 value steps fixed, cinnabar tint at 0.35 on the middle band.

name: mythSealScript
doc: hashed short glyph strokes — script field, not a paper strip
draws: a field of short hashed ink strokes that read like seal-script glyphs, a few of them red.
params: p: position on a 14 by 14 cell grid; t: unused in the current keep test; stroke length fixed at 0.42 and width at 0.035.

name: mythSootCrawl
doc: domain-warped fbm soot tongues crawling across a seal plate
draws: black soot tongues creeping sideways across a seal-grey plate, their edges warm with cinnabar.
params: p: screen position; t: downward crawl speed of the warp; tongue edge fixed by smoothstep 0.38 to 0.72, warp strength 0.55.

name: mythSootVeil
doc: full-frame ridged-noise veil — folded spines, not tongues
draws: a full-frame veil of folded black soot with ridged, spine-like creases.
params: p: screen position; t: slow drift of the warp; threshold fixed at 0.42 to 0.86, cinnabar tint at 0.4.

name: mythTalismanHatch
doc: diagonal hatch confined to ofuda cards — tone, not a seal square
draws: diagonal ink hatching inside a paper talisman card, with a red seal stamp at its top.
params: p: screen position; t: unused; card centre fixed at (0.72, 0.50), hatch density 28 lines, seal stamp at the card top.

name: mythTomoeSpiral
doc: logarithmic spiral of comma SDFs — r = a*exp(b*theta)
draws: eight comma-shaped marks spiralling outward from the centre over a red-tinged indigo cloud.
params: p: screen position; t: rotation speed of the spiral; 8 marks, growth 0.22 per mark, fbm backdrop fixed at scale 2.0.

name: mythTomoeTriple
doc: three comma SDFs orbit a seal pupil — magatama, not a frame copy
draws: three comma marks orbiting a black pupil inside a seal ring.
params: p: screen position around MY_C; t: orbit angle speed 0.35; orbit radius 0.16 and pupil radius 0.055 fixed.

name: mythTorchFlicker
doc: torch disc plus hash flicker plus glow falloff — light, not a maw
draws: a torch flame flickering in a dark cave, with a warm glow falling off around it and a dark stick below.
params: p: screen position relative to the torch at (0.72, 0.28); t: flicker timing via a hashed hold; flame radius 0.045 and glow falloff 14.0 fixed.

name: mythTsukiMoon
doc: hard moon disc plus umbra gradient on a red-indigo night
draws: a hard pale moon on a red-indigo night, shaded darker toward one edge.
params: p: screen position; t: slow sway of the moon centre; moon radius 0.16 and umbra range 0.16 to 0.42 fixed.

name: aoHeight
doc: height-based AO: multiply darkens low proxy values, stronger in cavities of the radial seat
functions: vec3 aoHeight(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float k)
draws: The low parts of the frame darken into soft shadow, deepest inside the radial seat's hollow.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; k: blend strength of the darkening (0 to 1)

name: bilateralIsh
doc: bilateral-ish bloom clamp: 5-tap, weight by luma delta, then ocCap
functions: vec3 bilateralIsh(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 res)
draws: The frame softens, blurring smooth areas while edges between different tones stay sharp.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; res: texture size, sets tap spacing

name: bloomClamp
doc: bilateral-ish bloom clamp: add excess above 0.72, then force luma <= 0.92
draws: Bright areas above a knee get a faint extra glow, capped before pure white.
params: c: input colour; knee: luma level where the extra glow starts

name: bloomLumaGate
doc: bloom only where luma > gate, then cap — a highlight pick, not a pyramid
draws: Only highlights brighter than a gate gain a little extra light, then the result is capped.
params: c: input colour; gate: luma threshold, with a fixed 0.12 ramp

name: bloomShoulder
doc: bloom shoulder: soft knee above 0.8 then ocCap — emissive only, never 1.0 whites
draws: Highlights roll off softly above 0.8 instead of clipping to white.
params: c: input colour only; knee fixed at 0.8

name: bloomSoftClamp
doc: soft bloom clamp: add a blurred-ish self * excess, hard luma 0.92
draws: Bright areas gain a soft extra glow scaled by how far they exceed mid-grey.
params: c: input colour only; threshold fixed at 0.62, gain 1.4

name: boxTap5
doc: 5x5 box tap (step 2): 9 samples, a chunkier downsample-ish flatten
functions: vec3 boxTap5(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 res)
draws: The frame is averaged over a 3x3 grid of spaced samples, so it looks softly flattened and chunkier.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; res: texture size, sets tap spacing (2 px)

name: cavityDark
doc: cavity AO: darken where the proxy is a local minimum vs a 4-tap screen neighbourhood
functions: vec3 cavityDark(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float k)
draws: Hollows where the depth proxy dips below its neighbours fall into a darker tone.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; k: darkening strength

name: channelRotateInvert
doc: RGB to GBR then invert and cap — a third JoJo-ish swap, not RB
draws: Colour channels are cycled green-blue-red and then inverted, giving an off-hue negative.
params: c: input colour only

name: chromaEdge
doc: edge-only CA: split only where fwidth(luma) is high
functions: vec3 chromaEdge(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, float px)
draws: Colour fringes appear only along high-contrast outlines, red shifted one way and blue the other.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; px: split distance in pixels

name: chromaImpact
doc: chromatic split along impact: offset toward a hit point, luma-gated
functions: vec3 chromaImpact(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 hit, float px)
draws: Colour fringes split out toward a hit point and show mostly on bright areas.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; hit: point the split points toward; px: split distance

name: chromaRadial
doc: radial chromatic split: offset along (uv-c), stronger with radius
functions: vec3 chromaRadial(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 c, float px)
draws: Colour fringes grow outward from the frame centre and are widest at the edges.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; c: centre; px: strength

name: chromaRG
doc: RG split only: red/green offset, blue stays — a cheaper impact CA
functions: vec3 chromaRG(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, float px)
draws: A red-green fringe slides sideways across the frame while blue stays put.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; px: horizontal offset in pixels

name: chromaSplit
doc: chromatic impact split: R/B offset along a direction, samples a source
functions: vec3 chromaSplit(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 dir, float px)
draws: Red and blue fringes slide apart along a fixed direction across the frame.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; dir: split direction; px: split distance

name: clockBullseye
doc: bullseye rings: fract(4r) alternate bands on a disc, AA isolines
functions: vec3 clockBullseye(vec2 p, vec3 face, vec3 ring, vec2 c, float R)
draws: A disc of alternating concentric rings, like a target or a stopped dial.
params: p: screen coordinate; face and ring: band colours; c: centre; R: radius

name: clockFaceTicks
doc: clock-face polar ticks: 12 hour ridges + 60 minute ticks, fwidth, screen polar
functions: vec3 clockFaceTicks(vec2 p, vec3 face, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float R)
draws: A clock face with twelve hour ridges and sixty fine minute ticks round its rim.
params: p: screen coordinate; face and ink: colours; c: centre; R: radius

name: clockHands
doc: tapered clock hands: SDF segments for minute/hour, AA, hub disc
functions: float ocHand(vec2 q, float ang, float len, float w0, float w1)
vec3 clockHands(vec2 p, vec3 face, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float R, float minA, float hourA)
draws: A clock face with tapered minute and hour hands and a central hub.
params: p, face, ink: as clockFaceTicks; c, R: centre and radius; minA, hourA: hand angles in radians

name: clockRimInk
doc: clock rim only: a thick AA annulus, no face, no hands
functions: vec3 clockRimInk(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float R)
draws: A thick ink ring drawn around a circle, with nothing inside it.
params: plate; ink: ring colour; c: centre; R: radius

name: contactShadow
doc: fake contact shadow: multiply dark disc under a screen-space seat, height-weighted
functions: vec3 contactShadow(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec2 seat, float r)
draws: A soft dark smudge sits under the seat, as if the hero is standing on the ground.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; seat: shadow position; r: radius

name: cornerPlates
doc: four corner hold cards: screen-space L-plates that pin the frame, AA on each card
functions: vec3 cornerPlates(vec3 plate, vec3 card, float s)
draws: Four L-shaped cards pin the corners of the frame.
params: plate: base colour; card: card colour; s: size of the corner cards

name: creaseDark
doc: crease darkening: where |laplacian| of the proxy is high, multiply a cool crease
functions: vec3 creaseDark(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float k)
draws: Thin cool shadow lines appear where the depth proxy bends sharply.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; k: strength

name: crossBokeh
doc: cross bokeh: 5-tap plus + 4-tap diagonals, a cheap anime sparkle blur
functions: vec3 crossBokeh(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 res)
draws: A soft sparkle blur spreads the frame horizontally, vertically and diagonally.
params: src: frame texture; uv: sample point; res: texture size, sets tap spacing (2.5 px)

name: darkMultiplyInk
doc: multiply ink on darks only: no edge gate, a value-key overlay
functions: vec3 darkMultiplyInk(vec3 plate, vec3 ink, float cut)
draws: The dark parts of the frame take on an ink tint, while bright parts stay as they are.
params: plate: base colour; ink: tint colour; cut: luma where the tint starts

name: depthBand
doc: quantized depth bands: floor the proxy into poster steps, ink the isolines with fwidth
functions: vec3 depthBand(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float steps)
draws: The image breaks into flat poster-like steps of tone, with thin lines at each step.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; steps: number of tone bands

name: depthFogOcclude
doc: depth fog occlude: lerp plate toward a haze as the proxy recedes, never milky-white
functions: vec3 depthFogOcclude(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 haze, float start, float end)
draws: Distant parts of the scene fade into a cool haze.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; haze: fog colour; start, end: fade range on the depth proxy

name: depthHalo
doc: depth-proxy halo: bright rim where the height/radial proxy has a discontinuity (fwidth ridge)
functions: vec3 depthHalo(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 rim, float gain)
draws: A glowing rim outlines where the depth proxy has a sharp step.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; rim: glow colour; gain: glow strength

name: depthRidge
doc: ridge highlight: add on rising proxy slopes (max(dFdy,0)), a cheap backlight
functions: vec3 depthRidge(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 hi)
draws: A faint warm highlight sits on the upward-facing slopes of the depth proxy.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; hi: highlight colour

name: depthSoftClip
doc: soft clip by depth-proxy: fade the plate out as proxy drops below a threshold, AA
functions: vec3 depthSoftClip(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 behind, float cut)
draws: The frame fades to a dark colour where the depth proxy drops below a cut.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; behind: colour beyond the cut; cut: threshold

name: diagonalMatte
doc: diagonal hold: a 45-degree half-plane matte with fwidth, glued vs plate
functions: vec3 diagonalMatte(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, float k)
draws: A hard 45-degree split: one half shows the frame, the other a solid colour.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; glue: solid colour; k: position of the split

name: diagonalSpeed
doc: diagonal speedlines: hashed bins along x+y, travelling dashes
functions: vec3 diagonalSpeed(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, float seed, float t)
draws: Diagonal speed streaks slide across the frame at an angle.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; ink: streak colour; seed: streak pattern; t: time

name: doubleRip
doc: two parallel rips: a torn strip of under-colour between two noisy edges
functions: vec3 doubleRip(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0, float w)
draws: A vertical strip of colour shows between two ragged cuts.
params: p: screen coordinate; plate: base colour; under: colour in the strip; x0: strip centre; w: half-width

name: dualDepthComp
doc: dual-depth composite: pick plate A or B by the depth-proxy, as two RTs + depth
functions: vec3 dualDepthComp(vec2 p, vec3 nearP, vec3 farP, float cut)
draws: The frame is split between two layers, chosen per pixel by depth.
params: p: screen coordinate; nearP: near layer colour; farP: far layer colour; cut: depth threshold

name: dualPlateSplit
doc: dual-plate split: left RT vs right RT, vertical AA seam at a ndc x
functions: vec3 dualPlateSplit(vec3 left, vec3 right, float seam)
draws: A left colour and a right colour meet along a vertical edge.
params: left, right: colours; seam: edge position in NDC x

name: dualPlateWipe
doc: dual-plate wipe: two colours as if two RTs, AA x-wipe between them
functions: vec3 dualPlateWipe(vec3 a, vec3 b, float u)
draws: Two colours meet along a wipe that sweeps across the frame.
params: a, b: colours; u: wipe position from 0 to 1

name: dualToneInvert
doc: invert, then map luma onto a two-stop grade (shadow/light), capped
functions: vec3 dualToneInvert(vec3 c, vec3 shadow, vec3 light)
draws: The frame turns into a two-tone negative in shadow and light colours.
params: c: input colour; shadow, light: the two grade colours

name: edgeAwareGrade
doc: edge-aware grade: 3-stop ramp only on fwidth edges, interiors stay
functions: vec3 edgeAwareGrade(vec3 plate, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
draws: Outlines in the frame pick up a three-colour gradient, while flat areas keep their colour.
params: plate: base colour; a, b, c: dark-to-light ramp colours

name: edgeInkOverlay
doc: edge-aware overlay: multiply ink on darks only, gated by fwidth luma
draws: Dark outlines get a coloured ink, flat areas stay unchanged.
params: plate: base colour; ink: ink colour

name: fboAddClamp
doc: FBO add-clamp: dst + src, then luma 0.92 — the additive layer of a premult pass
draws: A glowing layer is added on top of the frame and capped.
params: dst: base colour; src: layer added on top

name: fboPremultOver
doc: premultiplied over: out = src + dst*(1-a), the UBER compositor law
functions: vec3 fboPremultOver(vec3 dst, vec3 src, float a)
draws: A coloured layer is laid over the frame at a set opacity.
params: dst: base colour; src: layer colour; a: opacity

name: fboScreenBlend
doc: FBO screen blend: 1-(1-a)*(1-b), then luma-cap — additive-ish composite
draws: Two layers combine so the result is brighter than either alone.
params: a, b: the two colours to combine

name: focusConverge
doc: converging focus: line density increases toward the seat (1/r bins)
functions: vec3 focusConverge(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c)
draws: Dark rays that bunch closer and closer as they near a point, converging on the seat.
params: plate, ink colours; c the seat the lines converge on (density rises as 1/r)

name: focusHole
doc: focus hole: radial lines that leave a clean disc at the seat (no ink inside)
functions: vec3 focusHole(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float hole)
draws: Dark radial lines fanning out from the seat, with a clean empty disc at its centre.
params: plate, ink colours; c seat centre; hole radius of the empty disc

name: focusLines
doc: focus lines: same polar bins as speedlines but they stop short of a hole at the seat
functions: vec3 focusLines(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float hole, float seed)
draws: Dark radial streaks, some hashed out, that fade before the frame edge and stop short of a clear disc at the seat.
params: plate, ink colours; c seat; hole radius of the clear disc; seed picks which bins show

name: foldTear
doc: fold tear: a crease line plus a lifted flap (skewed half-plane), shade in the fold
functions: vec3 foldTear(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0)
draws: A page folded along a crease, with a lifted flap showing the under colour and a shaded fold.
params: plate, under colours; x0 crease position

name: freezeGrain
doc: freeze-frame grain: IGN-ish hash held on a stepped clock, luma-weighted, not rolling film
functions: vec3 freezeGrain(vec3 plate, float seed, float amt)
draws: Fine film grain held still between steps, strongest in the mid tones.
params: plate; seed sets the hold step; amt grain strength

name: freezeHold
doc: held-frame: quantize time inside the hash so the plate is a still with a locked grain
functions: vec3 freezeHold(vec3 plate, float t, float fps)
draws: A still frame with grain pinned to a stepped clock, so it looks held rather than rolling.
params: plate; t and fps set the hold step rate

name: freezePoster
doc: held poster: freeze-step the plate into N bins so a time-stop reads as a print
draws: The frame flattened into a few flat colour steps, like a printed poster.
params: plate; bins number of colour steps

name: freezeScan
doc: held scanlines: locked horizontal bars + grain, time-stop TV, AA via fwidth on the bar field
functions: vec3 freezeScan(vec3 plate, float seed, float n)
draws: Horizontal scanlines and grain locked in place, like a paused TV.
params: plate; seed grain pattern; n number of scan bars across the frame

name: frozenSpray
doc: frozen spray: hashed beads around a rim, held (no fall), time-stop droplets
functions: vec3 frozenSpray(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 bead, vec2 c, float R, float seed)
draws: Beads of spray hanging still in a ring around a point, not falling.
params: plate, bead colours; c centre; R ring radius; seed bead layout

name: grainHoldFrame
doc: coarse clumped grain locked to a seed, two scales, mid-weighted
functions: vec3 grainHoldFrame(vec3 plate, float seed, float amt)
draws: Coarse clumped grain held still, reading as heavier film grain than the fine version.
params: plate; seed grain layout; amt strength

name: greyExceptSeal
doc: desaturate the whole frame except an ellipse seat (hero keeps chroma)
functions: vec3 greyExceptSeal(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec2 c, vec2 rad)
draws: The whole frame drained to grey except an ellipse at the seat, which keeps its colour.
params: plate; c, rad ellipse centre and radii

name: greyHole
doc: grey hole: desaturate a screen disc (all-but-hero / all-but-foe), plate elsewhere
functions: vec3 greyHole(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec2 c, vec2 rad, float k)
draws: A disc at the seat drained to grey while the rest of the frame keeps its colour.
params: plate; c, rad ellipse centre and radii; k how far to drain

name: greyHoleIris
doc: iris-shaped grey hole: desaturate outside a growing disc, noisy rim
functions: vec3 greyHoleIris(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float k)
draws: A noisy-edged disc at the centre drained to grey, the outside keeping its colour.
params: plate; k disc radius (animate it for an iris); noise sets the rim

name: groundContact
doc: ground-plane contact: horizontal band at low p.y, width from proxy, multiply dirt
functions: vec3 groundContact(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float y0)
draws: A dark dirt band along a horizontal line near the bottom, as if the subject sits on the ground.
params: plate; y0 height of the ground line; depth proxy fades the band

name: haloInner
doc: inner halo: glow on the inside of the proxy body, opposite of an outer rim
functions: vec3 haloInner(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow)
draws: A warm glow just inside the edge of a body region, not outside it.
params: plate; glow colour

name: holdFrameMix
doc: hold-frame mix: blend a frozen (seeded) plate against live, as if two FBOs
functions: vec3 holdFrameMix(vec3 live, vec3 held, float k)
draws: A cross-fade between the live frame and a frozen one.
params: live, held plates; k mix amount 0 to 1

name: holdGhost
doc: hold ghost: a dim, offset earlier plate over live (onion of one frame)
functions: vec3 holdGhost(vec3 live, vec3 held, vec2 pxOff)
draws: A faint tinted copy of an earlier frame laid over the current one.
params: live, held plates; pxOff (not read by the code; the offset comes from the caller's plate)

name: holdOnion
doc: onion-skin hold: three time-offsets of a generated plate, weighted, as three held FBOs
functions: vec3 holdOnion(vec2 p, float t, float dt)
draws: A soft onion-skin trail: three offset copies of the scene blended together.
params: p, t position and time; dt time step between copies

name: holdStutter
doc: hold stutter: quantize the source UV in time-steps, a stepped FBO hold
functions: vec3 holdStutter(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, float t, float fps)
draws: The picture jitters in small steps, held between time steps.
params: src texture; t time; fps step rate

name: horizSpeedlines
doc: horizontal speedlines: hashed rows, travelling dashes, not radial
functions: vec3 horizSpeedlines(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, float seed, float t)
draws: Horizontal speed streaks as short dashes running across the frame.
params: plate, ink colours; seed row pattern; t time drives the motion

name: hueRotateInvert
doc: rotate hue 180 then invert value: complement wash, luma-capped
draws: The colours shifted across channels and then inverted, reading as a colour flip.
params: c colour input only

name: impactAnnuliPulse
doc: pulsing annuli: ring radius is a sin of time, two phases, additive
functions: vec3 impactAnnuliPulse(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec2 c, float t)
draws: Two thin rings that pulse outward from a point in time with the beat.
params: plate; a, b ring colours; c centre; t time drives the pulse

name: impactFlashDisc
doc: impact flash disc: solid AA disc that blooms-cap, the hit's first frame
functions: vec3 impactFlashDisc(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 flash, vec2 c, float r)
draws: A solid bright disc on the hit point, the first frame of an impact.
params: plate, flash colours; c centre; r radius

name: impactRing
doc: expanding impact ring: gaussian annulus |r-R|, additive, width from fwidth
functions: vec3 impactRing(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float R, float w)
draws: A bright ring expanding out from a point.
params: plate, glow colours; c centre; R ring radius; w width

name: invertEdgesOnly
doc: invert only on fwidth luma edges; interiors keep the plate
draws: Only the outlines of shapes flip to the inverse colour while the fills keep the picture.
params: c colour input; the edge mask comes from fwidth of luma, no other control

name: invertOutsideSeal
doc: luma-safe invert everywhere except an ellipse hole (hero keeps locked colour)
functions: vec3 invertOutsideSeal(vec2 p, vec3 c, vec2 seat, vec2 rad)
draws: The frame inverted everywhere except a clean ellipse at the seat, which keeps its colour.
params: p; c colour; seat, rad ellipse centre and radii

name: invertThenGrade
doc: invert, cap, then a 3-stop gradient map on the inverted luma
functions: vec3 invertThenGrade(vec3 c, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 d)
draws: The frame inverted, then mapped onto a three-colour gradient.
params: c colour; a, b, d gradient stops from shadow to light

name: irisGate
doc: iris wipe: circular aperture from screen centre, noisy edge, fwidth cover
functions: vec3 irisGate(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, float k)
draws: A circular aperture opening from the centre with a rough edge, the outside glued in colour.
params: plate, glue colours; k opening size; noise sets the rough edge

name: keyholeSeal
doc: keyhole hero seal: circle over a tapered slot, AA union, glued plate
functions: vec3 keyholeSeal(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, vec2 c)
draws: A keyhole-shaped window showing the scene, with glued colour around it.
params: plate, glue colours; c keyhole centre

name: letterboxBars
doc: cinematic letterbox: horizontal bars from |ndc.y|, fwidth on the bar edge
draws: Dark bars across the top and bottom of the frame.
params: plate; halfH half-height of the open area

name: lumaOnlyInvert
doc: invert luma, keep chromaticity: Y' = 1-Y then recap, rgb scaled
draws: Brightness flipped while the hue of each colour is kept.
params: c colour input only

name: lumaSafeInvert
doc: luma-safe invert: 1-rgb then compress so luma <= 0.92
draws: The picture's colours inverted.
params: c colour input only

name: midInvert
doc: invert the mids only: ends stay, a smooth-step window around 0.5 luma
draws: Only the middle tones flip, while the darkest and brightest areas stay.
params: c colour; w width of the mid window around 0.5 luma

name: motionStreak
doc: motion streak: 5-tap gather along a direction, a cheap smear (not a blur kernel)
functions: vec3 motionStreak(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 dir, float px)
draws: A smear of the frame streaking in one direction, like fast motion.
params: src texture; dir streak direction; px smear length

name: multiplyTint
doc: multiply tint wash: plate * mix(white, hue, k), JoJo palette-swap style
functions: vec3 multiplyTint(vec3 plate, vec3 hue, float k)
draws: The whole frame washed with one colour, darker where the frame is dark.
params: plate; hue tint colour; k strength

name: ndcPlate
doc: NDC fullscreen glued plate: colour from gl_FragCoord, clip-space quad covering the frame
draws: A solid colour wash inside a dark border, covering the full screen.
params: glue colour of the wash

name: ndcSplitPlate
doc: left/right NDC glued plates: two screen halves with an AA seam
functions: vec3 ndcSplitPlate(vec3 left, vec3 right, float seam)
draws: The screen cut in two halves along a vertical seam, each half a different plate.
params: left, right plate colours; seam x position

name: occludeByHeight
doc: height fade: plate multiplies toward ink as p.y drops, a cheap occlude-by-ground
functions: vec3 occludeByHeight(vec2 p, vec3 plate, float yCut)
draws: The bottom of the frame sinks toward dark ink as it gets lower.
params: plate; yCut height where the fade starts

name: occludeKit
doc: occlude compositor grammar: luma cap 0.92, fwidth AA, deep-multiply ink, screen uv, height/radial depth proxy
functions: float ocEllipse(vec2 p, vec2 c, vec2 rad)
float ocBox(vec2 p, vec2 c, vec2 b)
float ocStarN(vec2 p, float n, float r, float inner)
draws: Nothing on its own: the shared colour cap, anti-aliasing, shapes, noise and depth proxy that the other shaders call.
params: uRes screen size; uDepth optional proxy scale (default 1); ocInvert, ocAA, ocStroke, ocEllipse, ocBox, ocStarN, ocVnoise, ocDepthProxy, ocPlate

name: overlayDarks
doc: overlay blend on darks: Photoshop overlay vs ink, only L < 0.5
draws: The dark parts of the picture take on a multiply-style ink tint while the bright parts stay as they were.
params: plate: colour underneath; ink: colour laid over the darks

name: paperFiberRip
doc: paper-fiber rip: stretched noise along the tear, fibrous edge, underlayer
functions: vec3 paperFiberRip(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0)
draws: A torn edge runs down the frame with a frayed, fibrous rim and a paper-coloured layer showing beneath.
params: p: pixel position; plate: the picture; under: colour revealed by the tear; x0: horizontal tear position

name: peelCorner
doc: corner peel: a quadratic fold from a screen corner, underlayer + fold shade
functions: vec3 peelCorner(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float k)
draws: One corner of the picture peels back along a diagonal fold, shading the turned-over paper.
params: p; plate; under: colour under the peel; k: how far the fold reaches from the corner

name: pillarboxBars
doc: pillarbox: vertical side bars from |ndc.x|, fwidth on the bar edge
draws: Black vertical bars close in from the left and right, leaving a centred widescreen window.
params: plate; halfW: half-width of the open centre in NDC units

name: polarGrid
doc: polar grid: concentric rings + angular spokes, fwidth isolines
functions: vec3 polarGrid(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float rings, float spokes)
draws: Thin concentric rings and radial spokes are inked across the frame like a target or radar grid.
params: p; plate; ink; c: centre; rings: ring count; spokes: spoke count

name: polarHourMarks
doc: 12 thick hour marks only: |sin(6a)| ridges, no minute ticks
functions: vec3 polarHourMarks(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float R)
draws: Twelve thick tick marks sit on a circle around a centre point, like the hour positions of a clock face.
params: p; plate; ink; c: centre; R: dial radius

name: polarMinuteRidge
doc: 60 thin minute ridges: denser than hour marks, shorter radial span
functions: vec3 polarMinuteRidge(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float R)
draws: Sixty fine radial ticks sit in a ring just inside the edge, denser than the hour marks.
params: p; plate; ink; c; R: dial radius; tick count fixed at 60 by the frequency constant

name: polarSecondTicks
doc: 120 half-second marks: denser than minutes, very short radial ticks
functions: vec3 polarSecondTicks(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float R)
draws: About 120 very short ticks hug the rim, finer than the minute marks.
params: p; plate; ink; c; R: dial radius; tick count fixed at 120 by the frequency constant

name: posterInvert
doc: posterize then invert: floor to N bins, invert, luma-cap
draws: The picture is stepped into flat bands of colour and then inverted, like a poster print gone negative.
params: c: colour; bins: number of colour steps per channel

name: posterTear
doc: poster tear: torn-edge SDF (sine + noise) revealing an under-layer colour
functions: vec3 posterTear(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0)
draws: A poster is torn along a wavy, noisy edge, with a dark ink line on the tear and the colour below showing through.
params: p; plate; under: colour below the tear; x0: tear position

name: radialSpeedlines
doc: radial speedlines: hashed polar bins, taper with radius, fwidth width
functions: vec3 radialSpeedlines(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float seed)
draws: Fine ink lines radiate from a centre point, fading in from the middle and thinning out toward the edges.
params: p; plate; ink; c: burst centre; seed: changes which rays appear

name: rbSwapInvert
doc: JoJo-ish RB channel-swap then invert, then luma-cap (never raw 1-rgb whites)
draws: The red and blue channels swap and the colours invert, giving a sharp off-palette negative.
params: c: colour to process

name: rimLightProxy
doc: view-space rim: grazing term from the proxy gradient (screen dFdx/dFdy), additively capped
functions: vec3 rimLightProxy(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 rim)
draws: A soft light rim glows where the fake depth changes quickly across the screen, so edges catch light.
params: p: pixel position; plate; rim: rim light colour

name: ringDouble
doc: double impact ring: two annuli at R and R*1.35, different widths
functions: vec3 ringDouble(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float R)
draws: Two glowing rings expand from a point, one bright and one wider and dimmer.
params: p; plate; glow: ring colour; c: centre; R: first ring radius; second ring sits at 1.35R

name: ringExpandSoft
doc: soft expanding ring: wider gaussian, no hard stroke, fades with R
functions: vec3 ringExpandSoft(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float R)
draws: A single wide, soft glow ring spreads from a point and fades as it grows.
params: p; plate; glow; c: centre; R: ring radius, fade is 1-R

name: ringStack
doc: stacked rings: 5 discrete AA annuli, comic impact, not gaussian
functions: vec3 ringStack(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float r0)
draws: Five hard, comic-style ink rings stack close together around a point, like an impact burst.
params: p; plate; ink; c: centre; r0: first ring radius; rings sit 0.055 apart

name: ripJagged
doc: jagged rip: domain-warped vertical cut, high-frequency saw, underlayer
functions: vec3 ripJagged(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0)
draws: A jagged vertical tear with a ragged, high-frequency edge reveals the colour underneath.
params: p; plate; under: colour under the tear; x0: tear position

name: rippleCaustic
doc: caustic ripple: warped concentric rings via value-noise phase, not a clean shock
functions: vec3 rippleCaustic(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c)
draws: Wobbly concentric ripples spread from a point and bend like light through water, not a clean shock.
params: p; plate; glow: ripple colour; c: ripple centre

name: rippleMulti
doc: multi-ripple: three concentric gaussians at R, R-0.12, R-0.24
functions: vec3 rippleMulti(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float R)
draws: Three glowing rings stack outward from a point, each one dimmer than the last.
params: p; plate; glow; c: centre; R: front ring radius; others sit 0.12 and 0.24 inside

name: rippleSpiral
doc: spiral ripple: r - a*theta band, a spinning shock, fwidth
functions: vec3 rippleSpiral(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float twist)
draws: A glowing spiral band winds outward from a point and seems to spin as it expands.
params: p; plate; glow; c: centre; twist: rotation phase

name: safeAction
doc: action-safe inner frame: thin AA rule at a screen inset, plate dimmed outside
draws: A thin gold rule frames the picture inside an action-safe margin, with the outside dimmed.
params: plate; inset: margin as a fraction of the screen

name: scallopFrame
doc: scalloped oval frame: sine-modulated ellipse rim, fwidth fill outside
functions: vec3 scallopFrame(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, vec2 c, vec2 rad, float lobes)
draws: A scalloped oval window opens in the picture, its rim bumped like a stamp, with the glue colour filling the rest.
params: p; plate; glue: fill colour outside; c: centre; rad: x and y radius; lobes: number of scallops

name: sealCapsule
doc: stadium/capsule hero seal: two discs + a box, AA union, glued plate
functions: float ocCapsule(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b, float r)
vec3 sealCapsule(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, vec2 a, vec2 b, float r)
draws: A stadium-shaped window opens around the hero, with the picture inside and glue colour outside.
params: p; plate; glue; a, b: capsule end points; r: capsule radius

name: sealEllipse
doc: screen-ellipse hero seal: glued plate with an AA ellipse hole so the hero is never covered
functions: vec3 sealEllipse(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, vec2 c, vec2 rad)
draws: An elliptical hole is cut in the plate so the hero shows through, with the rest coloured in glue.
params: p; plate; glue; c: centre; rad: x and y radius

name: sealQuad
doc: rounded-quad hero seal: axis-aligned screen box hole with fwidth, glued plate around it
functions: vec3 sealQuad(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, vec2 c, vec2 b)
draws: A rectangular hole is cut in the plate so the hero shows through, with glue colour around it.
params: p; plate; glue; c: centre; b: half-size of the box

name: serratedTear
doc: serrated tear: triangle-wave edge (not noise), underlayer, AA
functions: vec3 serratedTear(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0, float teeth)
draws: A straight tear edge with a regular sawtooth zigzag shows the colour underneath.
params: p; plate; under; x0: tear position; teeth: zigzags per screen height

name: shatterStar
doc: broken-glass star: radial fracture from a point, hashed spoke lengths, inked
functions: vec3 shatterStar(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float n)
draws: Broken-glass spokes run out from a point, each a different random length, drawn in ink.
params: p; plate; ink; c: centre; n: number of spokes

name: shatterWedges
doc: shatter wedges: polar sectors offset by hash, inked cracks at sector edges
functions: vec3 shatterWedges(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, vec2 c, float n, float kick)
draws: The screen breaks into angular wedge pieces that drift a little apart, with dark cracks between them.
params: p; plate; under: shard colour; c: centre; n: number of wedges; kick: how far pieces shift

name: shockRipple
doc: shockwave UV ripple: uv += n * A * exp(-((r-R)/w)^2), samples a source plate
functions: vec2 shockRippleUv(vec2 uv, vec2 c, float R, float amp, float w)
vec3 shockRipple(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 c, float R, float amp)
draws: The picture bends outward from a point along a narrow shock ring as it passes.
params: src: plate texture; uv; c: centre; R: ring radius; amp: displacement strength; width fixed at 0.045

name: siloHalo
doc: silhouette halo: AA ring around the radial seat, additive gold, capped
functions: vec3 siloHalo(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 rim, vec2 c, vec2 rad)
draws: A thin gold halo ring is drawn around a seated silhouette.
params: p; plate; rim: halo colour; c: centre; rad: x and y radius

name: sobelInk
doc: Sobel-ish ink: 3x3 luma taps, overlay multiply on the gradient
functions: vec3 sobelInk(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 res, vec3 ink)
draws: Edges in the picture get dark inked outlines, traced from the brightness gradient.
params: src: plate texture; uv; res: screen size; ink: outline colour

name: softInvert
doc: partial invert: mix(c, 1-c, k) then cap, for a held-frame wash
draws: Colours are partly inverted, a washed-out negative that deepens as k rises.
params: c: colour; k: inversion amount from 0 to 1

name: softOccludeVig
doc: soft occlude vignette: quadratic screen falloff multiplied onto the plate, never a hard cut
draws: The corners of the frame darken smoothly into a soft vignette.
params: plate; k: how strongly the corners darken

name: solarize
doc: solarize: invert only where luma > hinge, then cap; keeps shadows
draws: Bright areas invert while dark areas keep their colour, giving a sharp band of negative highlights.
params: c: colour; hinge: luma above which colour inverts

name: speedlineBurst
doc: speedline burst: radial hashed rays that only live near the frame edge
functions: vec3 speedlineBurst(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float seed)
draws: Radial speed lines fan out from a point, showing only near the frame edges.
params: p; plate; ink; c: burst centre; seed

name: speedlineHash
doc: hashed speedline field: voronoi-ish cells stretched in X, inked long slashes
functions: vec3 speedlineHash(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, float seed)
draws: Long hashed ink slashes stream horizontally across the frame, like motion streaks.
params: p; plate; ink; seed: changes the random pattern

name: speedlineTaper
doc: tapered speedlines: each hashed row has a (1-u/len)^2 envelope
functions: vec3 speedlineTaper(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, float seed)
draws: Horizontal ink streaks of random length taper into thin tails across the frame.
params: p; plate; ink; seed: changes row lengths and widths

name: starBurst12
doc: 12-point starburst: clock-like burst, thin rays
functions: vec3 starBurst12(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float r)
draws: A twelve-point ink star sits at a point, with thin pointed rays.
params: p; plate; ink; c: star centre; r: star radius

name: starBurst4
doc: 4-point starburst: polar radius vs a 4-lobe star SDF, fwidth fill
functions: vec3 starBurst4(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float r)
draws: A four-point ink star sits at a point, like a sparkle.
params: p; plate; ink; c: star centre; r: star radius

name: starBurst6
doc: 6-point starburst: hex star, different inner ratio from the 4-point
functions: vec3 starBurst6(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float r)
draws: A six-point ink star sits at a point with broader rays than the four-point star.
params: p; plate; ink; c: star centre; r: star radius

name: starBurst8
doc: 8-point starburst: octogram, tighter waist than 6
functions: vec3 starBurst8(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float r)
draws: An eight-point star in a flat ink colour laid over a given plate, tighter at the waist than the six-point burst.
params: p: position; plate: colour under the star; ink: star colour; c: centre; r: outer radius.

name: starBurstAnamorphic
doc: anamorphic burst: wide horizontal streak + short vertical spike + core
functions: vec3 starBurstAnamorphic(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c)
draws: A wide horizontal light streak with a short vertical spike and a bright core sits over the plate.
params: glow colour; burst centre c; plate colour under the burst

name: starBurstAsterisk
doc: asterisk burst: cross plus diagonals, 8 boxes, distinct from polar starBurst8
functions: vec3 starBurstAsterisk(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float arm, float w)
draws: An eight-armed asterisk of ink bars bursts out from a point over the plate.
params: ink colour; centre c; arm length arm; bar width w

name: starBurstCross
doc: cross burst: plus-sign arms (axis-aligned), not a polar star
functions: vec3 starBurstCross(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float arm, float w)
draws: A plus sign of axis-aligned ink bars sits at a point over the plate.
params: ink colour; centre c; arm length arm; bar width w

name: starBurstHollow
doc: hollow star: AA shell of a star (stroke only), interior is plate
functions: vec3 starBurstHollow(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float n, float r)
draws: A star outline drawn as a thin stroke, with its inside left as the plate.
params: ink colour; centre c; point count n; outer radius r

name: starBurstSpark
doc: spark burst: hashed cells near a point become tiny AA diamonds
functions: vec3 starBurstSpark(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 spark, vec2 c, float seed)
draws: A scatter of tiny ink diamonds sparkles in hashed cells near a point.
params: spark colour; centre c; random seed

name: starBurstTaper
doc: tapered ray burst: N hashed polar spikes with (1-u)^2 falloff, fwidth width
functions: vec3 starBurstTaper(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float n, float seed)
draws: Thin tapered rays fan out from a point and fade with distance.
params: glow colour; centre c; ray count n; random seed

name: sweepMatte
doc: horizontal wipe matte: a moving x-bar that reveals the plate, AA on the head
functions: vec3 sweepMatte(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glue, float u)
draws: A vertical edge wipes across the frame, a dark matte covering one side and the plate showing on the other.
params: matte colour (glue); sweep position u from 0 to 1

name: tapBlur
doc: downsample-ish tap blur: 5-tap plus (centre + 4 diamond), not a real mip
functions: vec3 tapBlur(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 res)
draws: The frame softens under a light five-tap blur.
params: source texture; resolution res (sets tap spacing)

name: tapBlurDir
doc: directional tap blur: 7-tap along a vector, a cheap motion smear
functions: vec3 tapBlurDir(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 dir, vec2 res)
draws: The frame smears along one direction into a short motion streak.
params: source texture; smear vector dir; resolution res

name: tapKawaseApprox
doc: Kawase-ish downsample tap: centre*0.5 + 4 corners*0.125 (matches composer DOWN)
functions: vec3 tapKawaseApprox(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, vec2 res)
draws: The frame softens under a five-tap diagonal blur that looks almost the same as tapBlur.
params: source texture; resolution res

name: tearPerforation
doc: perforation tear: dashed holes along a line, then a peel past the dots
functions: vec3 tearPerforation(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0)
draws: A dashed row of tiny holes runs down a vertical line, and the strip beyond it peels away in under-colour.
params: plate colour; under-colour; tear line position x0

name: thresholdInvert
doc: hard two-tone: invert then threshold on luma, two inked swatches, no pure black
functions: vec3 thresholdInvert(vec3 c, float cut, vec3 hi, vec3 lo)
draws: The frame is inverted and cut to two flat inks, a dark plum and a warm gold.
params: cut level; highlight ink hi; shadow ink lo

name: tickSweep
doc: rotating highlight that sweeps clock ticks: a polar window, not a hand
functions: vec3 tickSweep(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c, float ang)
draws: A bright wedge sweeps round a centre like a clock hand's shadow, glowing where it passes.
params: glow colour; centre c; sweep angle ang

name: timeHoldBand
doc: horizontal freeze band: a screen strip holds a posterized invert, rest is live
functions: vec3 timeHoldBand(vec2 p, vec3 live, float y0, float h)
draws: A horizontal strip of the frame freezes and posterises while the rest keeps moving.
params: band centre y0; half-height h; freezePosterish helper from the kit

name: timeStopFlash
doc: time-stop flash: invert+tint hold, luma-capped, strength as a hard cut
functions: vec3 timeStopFlash(vec3 plate, vec3 tint, float on)
draws: The frame snaps to a tinted negative while switched on, then snaps back.
params: plate; tint colour; on as a hard 0 or 1 switch

name: tintMultiplySoft
doc: soft multiply: mix(plate, plate*hue, smooth luma window) so brights keep air
functions: vec3 tintMultiplySoft(vec3 plate, vec3 hue, float k)
draws: The mid-tones take on a teal wash while the brightest highlights stay clean.
params: hue colour; strength k

name: tintRamp
doc: 3-stop tint ramp by luma, multiply onto the plate
functions: vec3 tintRamp(vec3 plate, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
draws: The frame is recoloured through a three-stop ramp, plum to pink to gold, by brightness.
params: three stop colours a, b, c

name: tintSplitWash
doc: split-tone: shadows multiply cool, lights multiply warm, mid crossover
functions: vec3 tintSplitWash(vec3 plate, vec3 cool, vec3 warm)
draws: Shadows lean cool blue while highlights lean warm orange.
params: cool tint; warm tint

name: tornEdgeSdf
doc: torn-edge SDF only: a 1-px ink of the rip, plate otherwise
functions: vec3 tornEdgeSdf(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, float x0)
draws: A thin dark ink line traces a ragged vertical tear across the frame.
params: ink colour; tear position x0

name: tornHole
doc: torn hole: a noisy disc punched through the poster, fibrous rim
functions: vec3 tornHole(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, vec2 c, float r)
draws: A ragged-edged disc is punched through the poster, with a dark fibrous rim and the colour behind showing inside.
params: under colour; centre c; radius r

name: underColorSlash
doc: slash peek: a diagonal band of under-colour, AA sides, no torn noise
functions: vec3 underColorSlash(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float mid, float w)
draws: A diagonal band of under-colour slashes across the frame.
params: plate colour; under colour; band position mid; band width w

name: underlayerBleed
doc: under-layer bleed: torn edge plus a multiply stain leaking toward the plate
functions: vec3 underlayerBleed(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float x0)
draws: A torn edge with a stain of under-colour bleeding into the plate beside it.
params: under colour; tear line x0

name: underlayerPeek
doc: under-layer peek: a noisy blob hole showing a second colour, AA
functions: vec3 underlayerPeek(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, vec2 c, vec2 rad)
draws: A soft-edged blob reveals a second colour beneath the poster.
params: under colour; centre c; ellipse radii

name: valueInvertKeepHue
doc: HSV-ish: invert value, keep rg/b ratios (hue), then cap
draws: The frame's brightness is flipped while its hues stay, giving a dark negative in the same colours.
params: none beyond the input colour

name: volumeHalo
doc: volumetric-ish halo: exponential falloff from the seat through the proxy, additive
functions: vec3 volumeHalo(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 glow, vec2 c)
draws: A soft violet glow spreads from a point and fades out through the scene.
params: glow colour; centre c

name: washComplement
doc: complement flash: 2-frame style mix toward 1-hue, then cap
functions: vec3 washComplement(vec3 plate, vec3 hue, float k)
draws: The frame is pushed toward its complementary colour by a strength k.
params: hue colour; strength k clamped to 0 to 1

name: washDuotone
doc: duotone wash: replace chroma with a two-ink mix by luma, multiply amount
functions: vec3 washDuotone(vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec3 paper, float k)
draws: The frame is turned into two inks, a dark violet and a parchment, by brightness.
params: ink colour; paper colour; mix amount k

name: washEdgeBleed
doc: tint stronger at the frame edge (screen radial), a colour-script border wash
functions: vec3 washEdgeBleed(vec3 plate, vec3 hue, float k)
draws: The edges of the frame take on a pink colour wash while the centre stays clean.
params: edge hue; strength k

name: wedgeCrack
doc: single growing crack: a polar half-plane plus a noisy SDF cut, inked
functions: vec3 wedgeCrack(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 ink, vec2 c, float ang, float open)
draws: A single inked crack grows out from a point along a noisy edge.
params: ink colour; centre c; crack angle ang; opening width open

name: wedgeTear
doc: wedge tear: a triangular bite from the edge revealing under-colour
functions: vec3 wedgeTear(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, vec2 tip, float open)
draws: A triangular bite is taken out of the edge of the frame, showing under-colour.
params: under colour; tip position tip; opening angle open

name: zipTear
doc: zip tear: a travelling head plus a finished cut behind it, hashed teeth
functions: vec3 zipTear(vec2 p, vec3 plate, vec3 under, float head)
draws: A zipper-like tear travels down the frame, with ink teeth behind the moving head.
params: under colour; head position head (0 to 1)

name: aizenStillDesert
doc: Las Noches still: desert #f4e8c8, sky #0a0614, hard horizon, no motion boil
draws: A still desert at dusk: sand dunes under a dark violet sky with a hard horizon and a pale throne silhouette on the right.
params: p: plate position (horizon at y 0.36); t: unused, static still

name: fountainBasin
doc: Immortality fountain basin: circular water, stone lip, interior temple
draws: A round stone fountain basin with teal water and a ripple ring spreading across the pool.

name: orenNayarCel

name: orenNayarCloth
doc: Oren–Nayar cloth: high σ, dye albedo, cooler fill

doc: Water F + body cel: deep plates, one horizon chip

draws: A flat disc with an ink outline that is thin on its upper-left lit edge and thick on its lower-right shadow edge.

doc: thick confident outline whose width swells from 1.2 px on the lit side to 2.4 px on the shadow side

draws: Rolling dunes made only of thin cream contour lines on near-black ground under a flat dark sky, with grey hatching on each shadowed slope, appearing from the horizon forward.

doc: dunes drawn as cream contour lines over a near-black ground, hatched on the shadow side, drawn far to near

name: pierrotEye
draws: A wide almond eye with a solid coloured iris, a dark pupil, one hard white catchlight and a thick ink upper lid that drops as the lid closes.

name: pierrotFur
