doc: thin day/night terminator stripe with fwidth, dusk on the lit side
draws: a thin dusky stripe where day meets night on a sky plane
params: p only; stripe at x 0.62 with sine wobble 0.04; width 0.045

name: terminator-haze
doc: haze along the planet terminator
draws: a soft ember haze along the day-side edge of a dark planet
params: p only; planet centre (0.72,0.40) radius 0.26 hardcoded; haze weight 0.25

name: transit-silhouette
doc: transit: small dark disc on a bright limb-dark star
draws: a small dark planet crossing the face of a bright limb-darkened star
params: p only; star (0.72,0.50) radius 0.22; planet (0.78,0.52) radius 0.045 hardcoded

name: twilight-arc
doc: twilight arc: thin scatter along the lit limb only
draws: a thin orange scatter line hugging the lit edge of a planet
params: p only; planet (0.72,0.38) radius 0.25 hardcoded; arc width 0.01

name: twilight-grade
doc: three-stop elevation twilight: indigo zenith, ember belt, void ground
draws: an ember-to-void sky gradient with a faint warm belt near the horizon
params: p only; y clamped 0 to 1; belt at y 0.22 with weight 0.08

name: twilight-moon
doc: twilight grade plus a limb-darkened moon disc, fwidth edge
draws: the same ember-to-void sky gradient with a limb-darkened moon disc at upper right
params: p only; moon (0.92,0.72) radius 0.11 hardcoded; limb exponent 0.55

name: variable-twinkle
doc: stepped twinkle: magnitude gated by floor(t*12)
draws: a field of stars that step in brightness, each on its own timing
params: p, t: t steps brightness at 12 steps per unit time; cell 22, power 5 hardcoded

name: void-lens
doc: lens of an empty field — warp visible only as a dim grid
draws: a faint dim grid bent around a point, with the centre dark
params: p only; centre (0.72,0.52) hardcoded; warp 0.18/r; grid 40 lines

name: void-well
doc: deeper radial well — falloff from a hashed centre
draws: a dark pit at a fixed centre, indigo fading outward with a fbm-roughened edge
params: p only; centre (0.68,0.55) hardcoded; falloff 2.4 plus fbm

name: warp-well
doc: deep 1/r well — stronger clamp, more deflection
draws: a deep dark pit with dim teal fbm texture pulled around it by a strong 1/r warp
params: p only; centre (0.72,0.52), warp 0.32/r, hole radius 0.055 hardcoded

name: zodiacal-wedge
doc: zodiacal light: a wedge along the ecliptic
draws: A faint gold wedge of zodiacal light rising from the lower left toward the upper right along the ecliptic, widening and fading as it goes, on a void ground.
params: p: plate-space position; wedge runs from (0.15, 0.18) to (1.2, 0.42), width 0.03 to 0.15. No time input.

name: topoAlphaComplex
doc: alpha complex: Delaunay faces whose circumradius ≤ α and Voronoi hits the ball
draws: A pale field with an amber patch of Delaunay faces and rust Voronoi slivers that grow and shrink as the radius alpha changes.
params: t: pulses alpha between 0.10 and 0.20. No uniforms.

name: topoAlphaFiltration
doc: alpha-complex radius: faces whose circumradius is ≤ α, drawn as growing disks
draws: Amber disks swell around landmarks, and rust faces light up where neighbouring disks meet.
params: t: sets alpha between 0.08 and 0.22, which is the disk radius.

name: topoAscendingManifold
doc: ascending (unstable) manifold of a saddle: points flowing away under +grad
draws: A birth-teal arm fans out from a saddle point along the flow away from it, over a shaded height field.
params: Time is unused. The gradient at each pixel sets the arm direction and the saddle sits at a fixed point.

name: topoBarcodeH0
doc: H0 barcode only: connected-component bars from a merge tree (elder deaths)
draws: Three horizontal bars in birth teal, mint and amber stacked over a shaded height field.
params: t: slides the ends of two bars by a few percent.

name: topoBarcodeH1
doc: H1 barcode: loop bars born at saddles and dying at the filling height
draws: A magenta loop ring and a dark bar sit on a shaded field, and the loop radius pulses.
params: t: loop radius and bar length, each by a few percent.

name: topoBetti0MergeTree
doc: Betti-0 merge tree: leaves are maxima, internal nodes are elder-rule merges
draws: A fixed three-leaf merge tree drawn over a faint height field, with two birth-coloured leaves joining at a saddle node.
params: t: moves the merge node vertically by 0.04.

name: topoBetti1CycleInk
doc: Betti-1 cycle representative: a non-bounding loop inked where a 1-class lives
draws: One jagged loop in death magenta with a saddle-coloured tint where the loop passes a critical point.
params: t: pulses the loop radius. The jag is a fixed noise term.

name: topoBetti2VoidShell
doc: Betti-2 void: a cavity shell (2-cycle) born when a hollow closes
draws: A hollow shell of void-tinted band around a centre, with death and ink rims at its inner and outer edges.
params: t: moves the inner radius by 0.03.

name: topoBettiCurve
doc: Betti curve β_k(α): rank of homology vs filtration value, as a step function
draws: A birth-teal step profile that rises and falls with the filtration value, with a saddle-coloured sweep line crossing it.
params: t: position of the sweep line, fract(t*0.08). The step heights are hard-coded.

name: topoBettiStair
doc: Betti stair (β0, β1, β2) as three step traces against the filtration axis
draws: Three stair-step traces in teal, magenta and void, stacked against the filtration axis.
params: t: the width of the third trace's step.

name: topoBottleneckBalls
doc: bottleneck balls: L∞ neighborhoods of diagram points; radius is the bottleneck distance
draws: Three L-infinity squares around diagram points, in birth, death and void tints, each with an ink outline.
params: t: radius of all three squares, about 0.06 to 0.12.

name: topoBottleneckSmear
doc: bottleneck matching: L∞ balls and matching segments between two diagrams
draws: Two groups of tinted L-infinity squares joined by ink segments that show a bottleneck matching.
params: t: moves one diagram point horizontally by 0.04 and the square width by 0.02.

name: topoBoundaryCycle
doc: boundary of a 2-chain: ∂σ² is a 1-cycle that bounds, hence is zero in H1
draws: A triangle outline whose edges glow in birth teal, a boundary that bounds.
params: t: moves the apex vertically by 0.04.

name: topoCancelPair
doc: Morse cancellation: a min–saddle (or saddle–max) pair that can be cancelled
draws: A birth dot and a saddle dot joined by a line that shifts between ink and death colour.
params: t: blend between ink and death colour along the connecting line.

name: topoCechBallCover
doc: Čech ball cover: closed balls of radius ε around landmarks
draws: Teal discs with ink rings around nine landmarks, the discs breathing in and out.
params: t: radius breathes between 0.10 and 0.20. uScale multiplies the radius.

name: topoCechCochain
doc: Čech 0- and 1-cochains: values on sets and on overlaps
draws: Two overlapping discs, one amber-teal and one mint-rust, with a saddle-coloured overlap whose strength follows the two cochain values.
params: t: the two cochain values s0 and s1 vary sinusoidally.

name: topoCechH0
doc: Čech H^0: equalizer of restrictions — global sections as matching colours
draws: A flat birth-teal field with a mint band where local values agree, and ink rings at five landmarks.
params: t: moves the matching level s by about 0.12.

name: topoCechH1
doc: Čech H^1: a 1-cocycle obstruction that cannot be a coboundary (colour twist)
draws: A ring between radii 0.16 and 0.34 whose colour winds once around the centre, like a twisted cocycle.
params: t: rotates the winding phase slowly.

name: topoCechNerve
doc: Čech nerve of balls: a simplex iff the balls have common intersection
draws: Three discs whose triple overlap shows as a death-coloured core, with pairwise overlaps in birth teal.
params: t: disc radius, about 0.13 to 0.21.

name: topoCechVsRips
doc: Čech ⊂ VR: Čech faces in teal, extra Rips-only faces in magenta
draws: Teal Čech overlap discs next to Rips-only triangle edges, with a magenta marker at the centre of the extra faces.
params: t: radius r, about 0.13 to 0.19. It sets both the Čech discs and the Rips threshold 2r.

name: topoCheegerSweep
doc: Cheeger sweep cut: threshold the Fiedler function, boundary is the Cheeger set
draws: A half-plane split by a moving threshold of the Fiedler mode, with the boundary line in saddle colour.
params: t: threshold swings by about plus or minus 0.15.

name: topoClusterNerve
doc: clustering-on-cover nerve: each interval is clustered, clusters become vertices
draws: Two columns of filter bands, each with a saddle node at its centre, and ink edges joining the nodes.
params: t: shifts the band boundaries by about 0.05.

name: topoCoboundaryDelta
doc: Čech coboundary δ: (δs)_{UV} = s_V|U∩V − s_U|U∩V on overlaps
draws: Two overlapping boxes where the overlap ripples between ink and death tones, showing a coboundary value.
params: t: phase of the ripple.

name: topoCoboundaryHatch
doc: discrete coboundary δ = *d*: dual-edge fluxes from primal 1-cochains
draws: A grid of dual cells with tinted flux shading and amber discs at the dual centres.
params: Time is unused. The grid is fixed at 7 by 5 and the flux tanh scale is 5.

name: topoCocycleHighlight
doc: cohomology cocycle: a dual 1-cochain that pairs to 1 on a generating cycle
draws: A stippled ring with an amber arc marking the half of the loop where the cocycle pairs to one.
params: t: rotates the arc slowly.

name: topoConnectedComponents
doc: labeled H0 components of a superlevel: one colour per class
draws: A superlevel set coloured by which peak owns each component, in birth teal or death magenta, with a sweeping threshold.
params: t: threshold level, which moves with sin(t*0.4).

name: topoConstantSheaf
doc: constant sheaf: every stalk is the same group, restriction maps are id
draws: A flat birth-teal field with ink rings at six landmarks and an amber centre dot.
params: t: moves the six ring sites. Alias of topoCechH0: same flat tint with landmark rings.

name: topoContourTree
doc: contour tree = join tree + split tree glued at regular levels
draws: A fixed contour tree glyph: an amber top node, a saddle middle node, and teal and magenta branches.
params: t: sways the left branch end by 0.04.

name: topoCotanLaplacian
doc: cotan-Laplace on a terrain graph: Δf ≈ sum cot(α)(f_j−f_i) as a field
draws: A field tinted teal or rust by the sign of the Laplacian of the height, with an ink line where it is zero.
params: Time is unused. The Hessian trace of the height sets the tint.

name: topoCoverMultiplicity
doc: cover multiplicity: how many sets contain the point, the Čech degree
draws: A three-colour map of how many of nine discs cover each point, with rust at the highest counts.
params: t: disc radius, about 0.15 to 0.21.

name: topoCoverRefinement
doc: cover refinement: a finer cover maps onto a coarser nerve (refinement arrows)
draws: Two rows of small discs, one coarse and one fine, joined by a single rust arrow.
params: t: none. Positions are fixed.

name: topoCriticalOrbit
doc: critical orbit of a time-varying Morse function: crits trace paths in the plane
draws: Two moving critical points, amber and magenta, each leaving a fading teal trail, with a saddle between them.
params: t: sets the orbit phase. The trail is fixed at 8 samples.

name: topoCutLocus
doc: cut locus of a source: points with two minimizing geodesics
draws: A fixed band of equal distance between a source and two far points, with a rust ridge where two geodesics tie.
params: Time is unused. Source and far points are fixed.

name: topoCycleBasis
doc: homology cycle basis: independent loops spanning H1, inked as a generating set
draws: Three coloured rings, teal, magenta and a dim void ring, marking independent loops.
params: t: radius of the outer ring, about 0.25 to 0.31.

name: topoDeathBirth
doc: death-versus-birth scatter (axes swapped): off-diagonal still means persist > 0
draws: A scatter on an ink frame with a magenta death point and a teal birth point.
params: t: moves the death point horizontally by 0.04.

name: topoDensityFiltration
doc: density filtration: sublevel of a kernel density estimate over landmarks
draws: A kernel density picture: teal bands by density, with an ink contour at the chosen level.
params: t: kernel width 0.08 to 0.14, and level a from 0.18 to 0.40.

name: topoDescendingManifold
doc: descending (stable) manifold of a saddle: points flowing in under −grad
draws: A magenta arm fans inward to a saddle along the descending flow over a height field.
params: Time is unused. The gradient sets the arm direction.

name: topoDiagramH0H1
doc: two-dimension diagram: H0 squares and H1 diamonds on one birth–death plane
draws: A two-class diagram with teal squares for H0 and magenta diamonds for H1 on the birth-death plane.
params: t: wobbles the H0 point height by 0.03.

name: topoDiscreteHodge
doc: DEC Hodge star: primal cells vs dual cells, area ratios as brightness
draws: A grid of mint primal squares with amber dual discs, under ink grid lines.
params: Time is unused. The grid is fixed at 6 by 4.5.

name: topoDistanceFiltration
doc: distance-to-set filtration {x : d(x,S) ≤ r} of a landmark set S
draws: A distance field from landmarks, banded from teal to paper, with an ink contour at a breathing radius.
params: t: contour radius, about 0.06 to 0.22.

name: topoEigenGap
doc: spectral gap λ₂−λ₁ as stripe density: tighter gap, wider wash
draws: A mint wash with rust contour stripes whose spacing shifts as the spectral gap opens and closes.
params: p: plane position; t: sweeps the mix weight between the two eigenmodes

name: topoExcursionSet
doc: excursion set of a Gaussian-like field {x : fbm(x) ≥ u} with isoline boundary
draws: A paper field with an ink-and-violet region where a noise field rises above a drifting threshold, outlined in rust.
params: p: plane position; t: drifts the threshold u

name: topoExtendedPersistence
doc: extended persistence: ordinary sublevel bars plus relative/superlevel bars on one scale
draws: Teal and rose bands that trade places as two levels slide past each other, with rust outlines at both levels.
params: p: plane position; t: slides the two levels a and 1-a

name: topoExteriorDerivativeHatch
doc: discrete exterior derivative d on 0-forms: edge values f_j − f_i as hatch
draws: A grid of cells whose edges are hatched teal or rose by the sign of the difference between neighbouring values, with ink cell borders.
params: p: plane position (grid of 8 by 6 cells); t: unused

name: topoFiedlerPartition
doc: Fiedler vector cut: sign of the first nontrivial Laplacian eigenfunction
draws: A two-tone split of the plane into mint and teal halves divided by a wavy ink contour that drifts slightly.
params: p: plane position; t: wobbles the weight of the second mode

name: topoFilterCover
doc: cover of the filter range: overlapping intervals on the value axis, lifted
draws: A shaded landscape with a vertical filter axis on the right and four overlapping teal intervals marked on it, with mint bands across the field.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoFormLaplacian
doc: Hodge Laplacian Δ = dδ + δd banding on a 0-form
draws: Stepped bands from ink to mint with rust contour lines, changing where the Hessian trace crosses zero.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoGaussBonnetPatch
doc: Gauss–Bonnet patch: ∫K plus geodesic curvature on the boundary circle
draws: A disk patch whose interior is tinted by curvature, with a rust boundary ring and amber angular ticks around its edge.
params: p: plane position; t: rotates the amber angular ticks

name: topoGaussianCurvatureStripes
doc: Gaussian curvature K of the graph z=f: isolines of det(II)/det(I)
draws: A paper field tinted rose or teal by the sign of Gaussian curvature, with thin ink isolines where curvature is zero.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoGeodesicCurvature
doc: geodesic curvature κ_g of a plane curve on the graph surface
draws: A wobbling ring shaded teal-to-rust, brighter where the ring bends more sharply.
params: p: plane position; t: advances the wobble phase of the ring

name: topoGeodesicDistance
doc: geodesic distance field from a source, heat-method look (distance isolines)
draws: Concentric quantised distance rings spreading from a rose source dot across a teal-to-paper gradient.
params: p: plane position; t: drifts the source point horizontally

name: topoGeodesicFan
doc: geodesic polar coordinates: radial geodesics and distance circles from a pole
draws: Radial ink spokes and concentric teal distance circles around a fixed pole, over a paper field.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoGermPlot
doc: germs at a point: equivalence classes of local sections agreeing on a neighborhood
draws: Concentric teal and rose rings around a point, with the centre shaded by a local germ value.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoGoodCoverTest
doc: good-cover test: nerve vs space — contractible overlaps tint teal, failures rust
draws: Two overlapping disks whose overlap glows teal where it is contractible and rust where a hole appears.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the two site centres

name: topoGradientLikeField
doc: gradient-like Morse vector field: arrows decrease f, vanish only at crits
draws: A field of small ink hatch arrows pointing downhill across the plane, fading out to rust dots at the critical points.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoGromovHausdorffHint
doc: Gromov–Hausdorff hint: correspondence smear between two finite metric samples
draws: Five rose segments linking points of two clouds, one teal and one rose, sliding slightly as time moves.
params: p: plane position; t: slides the second point cloud

name: topoHandleAttach
doc: handle attachment: index-k handle glued at a critical value, shown as a k-cell
draws: Three marked shapes on a banded field: a teal disk, a rust ring and a small rose handle, one per Morse index.
params: p: plane position; t: breathes the band level a

name: topoHarmonic1Form
doc: harmonic 1-form on an annulus: dα=0 and δα=0, circulating field
draws: An annulus of ink streamlines circulating around a centre on a paper field, with the stream slowly turning.
params: p: plane position; t: scrolls the stream phase

name: topoHeatKernelTrace
doc: heat-kernel diagonal K_t(x,x): local spectral density, brighter at bottlenecks
draws: A paper field tinted by the sum of twelve decaying spectral modes, brighter amber where local heat concentrates.
params: p: plane position; t: sets the diffusion time tau

name: topoHeatMethodVaradhan
doc: Varadhan formula: dist ~ sqrt(−4τ log k_τ) as τ→0, heat wash to distance
draws: Amber-to-paper distance rings from a fixed source with a teal heat glow and an ink isoline.
params: p: plane position; t: sets the diffusion time tau

name: topoHeightReebTerrain
doc: height-function Reeb of a terrain plate: contours plus the Reeb quotient graph
draws: A terrain of stepped ink and mint contours with rust contour rings and an amber spine line across the plate.
params: p: plane position; t: slides the terrain horizontally

name: topoHodgeCodifferential
doc: codifferential δ = *d*: divergence hatch of a 1-form, image of d*
draws: A divergence map: teal and rose regions with ink contours where the divergence is zero.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoHodgeGradient
doc: exact 1-forms df: gradient hatch of a 0-form, the image of d₀
draws: A Morse-tinted field crossed by diagonal ink hatching aligned with its gradient direction.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoHodgeHarmonicStream
doc: Hodge harmonic 1-form: a divergence-free curl-free stream (ker Δ₁)
draws: Ink hatch lines following a circulating vortex around an amber dot, reading as a stream with no sources.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoHodgeStarStripe
doc: Hodge star * : k-forms → (n−k)-forms, drawn as rotated hatch
draws: Two crossing stripe families in teal and rose on a Morse field, the dominant family swapping as time moves.
params: p: plane position; t: crossfades which stripe family shows

name: topoIndex1Separatrix
doc: index-1 separatrices: the four rays leaving a 2D saddle
draws: Four rust rays leaving a saddle at the centre of a Morse-tinted paper field.
params: p: plane position; t: unused (static)

name: topoInjectivityRadius
doc: injectivity radius field: distance to the cut locus from each point
draws: A paper field graded mint-to-rose, brightest where the two nearest sites are far apart.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the sites

name: topoInteriorProduct
doc: interior product ι_X α: contracting a 1-form by a vector field
draws: An amber-to-ink tint with teal hatch lines running in the direction of a moving vector field.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the vector field X

name: topoInterleavingDistance
doc: persistence interleaving: two filtrations smeared by ε-shifts, distance is min ε
draws: Two shifted threshold regions, teal and rose, overlapping in rust where they meet.
params: p: plane position; t: sets the shift eps

name: topoInterlevelWindow
doc: interlevel set {x : a ≤ f(x) ≤ b} — the window whose persistence is death−birth
draws: A mint band between two level lines, with teal and rose edge contours bounding the window.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the window centre and half-width

name: topoIntersectLens
doc: pairwise ball lenses: the Čech 1-simplices as football-shaped intersections
draws: A single lens-shaped overlap of two disks, rose on a mint paper field.
params: p: plane position; t: sets the disk radius and moves sites 2 and 5

name: topoIntervalDecomp
doc: interval-module decomposition: indecomposable bars [b,d) stacked by dimension
draws: Stacked horizontal bars in teal, mint, rose and violet with ink tick marks along the base.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the end of the second bar

name: topoIsolineBirth
doc: isolines f=α appear at critical values; ink only at regular levels, rust at births
draws: Seven ink contour lines across a Morse field, with rust tints where contours are born at critical points.
params: p: plane position; t: shifts the contour levels slightly

name: topoJoinTree
doc: join tree of a sublevel filtration: components join as α increases
draws: A small tree of two teal branches meeting at a rust join point above two ink nodes.
params: p: plane position; t: bobs the join point

name: topoKit
doc: shared topology palette, AA, Morse field, sites, heat, eigenmodes — not a demo shader
functions: float tIso(float f, float lvl, float px)
float tBand(float f, float a, float b)
float tHeat(vec2 p, vec2 s, float tau)
float tVaradhan(vec2 p, vec2 s, float tau)
float tMode(vec2 p, float n, float m)
float tDisk(vec2 p, vec2 c, float r)
float tSeg(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b, float w)
float tBox(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b)
vec3 tMix3(float u, vec3 a, vec3 b, vec3 c)
draws: Nothing on its own: it supplies the paper-and-ink palette, anti-aliasing, Morse field and eigenmode helpers the other topo shaders call.
params: none: library of functions taking p (plane position) and t (time) as arguments

name: topoLandscapeIntegral
doc: landscape integral ∫ λ_k: area under each tent as a persistence statistic
draws: A teal area under a tent-shaped curve with an amber marker bar on the right.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the marker bar height

name: topoLaplacianEigenband
doc: graph Laplacian eigenmode: nodal bands of sin(nπx)sin(mπy) on the rectangle
draws: Ink-and-teal nodal bands of one sine mode on the rectangle, with the band pattern changing as the mode indices step.
params: p: plane position; t: steps the mode indices n and m

name: topoLazyWitness
doc: lazy witness: a simplex is kept if some witness is within ν of all its vertices
draws: A teal witness dot and two landmark dots, joined by an ink edge only when the witness is close enough to both.
params: p: plane position; t: moves the sites and varies the witness radius nu

name: topoLensCover
doc: lens cover: pairwise ball lenses as the geometric 1-simplices
draws: Eight pale rose lenses where neighbouring disks overlap, over a paper field with faint teal disks.
params: p: plane position; t: breathes the lens radius r

name: topoLevelsetSweep
doc: continuous level-set sweep: α(t) paints only the current regular level as a traveling front
draws: A teal front sweeping across a Morse-tinted field, with a rose ink contour at the current level.
params: p: plane position; t: sets front position a as fract(t times 0.12)

name: topoLifetimeHistogram
doc: lifetime histogram: counts of bars by death−birth, persistence as a statistic
draws: A row of eight bars rises and falls across the frame, teal shifting to magenta from left to right.
params: t: slow bar-height wobble; p.x: picks one of 8 bins; bin heights decay with index.

name: topoLocalToGlobal
doc: local-to-global gluing: matching local sections become one global section
draws: A split frame where teal and magenta local patches blend into one mint field as the seam closes.
params: t: blend between local and global section; seam fixed at x=0.72.

name: topoLoopWinding
doc: winding number of a 1-cycle around a point: the pairing ⟨cocycle, cycle⟩
draws: A ring around a centre point, coloured by angle, with a dark loop line and a small saddle dot at the middle.
params: t: rotates the angular phase; centre (0.72,0.5); ring radius 0.24.

name: topoLowerStar
doc: lower-star filtration of a grid: a cell enters when its highest vertex does
draws: A grid of cells that light up in turn as a filtration level sweeps, each lit cell tinted by its highest corner.
params: t: filtration level 0.2 to 0.75; grid 10 by 7 cells; grid line strength fixed.

name: topoMapperEdges
doc: Mapper edges only: adjacency of clusters in consecutive filter intervals
draws: Five amber-and-teal cluster dots in two rows joined by short ink edges, drifting gently.
params: t: vertical wobble of the upper row; background tint from the filter tMorse(p).

name: topoMapperNerve
doc: Mapper nerve: overlap graph of a pullback cover of a filter
draws: Three amber nodes joined in a chain over a tinted background.
params: t: unused; node positions fixed; background tint from the filter.

name: topoMatchingDiagram
doc: explicit bijection lines between two persistence diagrams (partial matching)
draws: Three ink lines linking points on a left diagram to points on a right diagram, their right ends wobbling.
params: t: wobble of the right endpoints (about 0.08); point sets fixed.

name: topoMaxminLandmarks
doc: maxmin landmark selection: greedy farthest-point sampling of the metric space
draws: Amber landmark dots appear one by one, their count pulsing between three and nine, with a faint halo near the field.
params: t: landmark count 3 to 9 over time; site positions fixed.

name: topoMeanCurvature
doc: mean curvature H stripes of the graph z=f
draws: Amber-to-ink bands show the mean curvature of a height field, with a saddle-coloured zero contour.
params: t: unused; H from tMeanH(p); contour width 1.4 at H=0.

name: topoMedialAxis
doc: medial axis of a domain: points with two closest boundary sites
draws: A bright ridge of points equidistant from two nearest boundary sites, with a mint glow inside the domain.
params: t: moves the boundary sites; ridge width 0.025; glow radius 0.22.

name: topoMergeElderRule
doc: elder rule: at a merge the younger component dies; death ink on the younger basin
draws: Two basins coloured teal and magenta under a sweeping level line, with the younger basin shaded amber.
params: t: level a sweeps 0.3 plus or minus 0.25; basin centres fixed.

name: topoMetricNerve2Simplices
doc: nerve 2-simplices of a metric ball cover: filled triples with nonempty intersection
draws: A filled triangle wherever three pulsing discs overlap, outlined in ink.
params: t: disc radius 0.20 plus or minus 0.05; sites 0, 2 and 5 via tSite.

name: topoMetricThickening
doc: metric thickening / offset: X^r = {y : d(y,X) ≤ r} of a landmark set
draws: Concentric banding of distance from landmark points, with a paper halo that grows and shrinks.
params: t: thickening radius r from 0.05 to 0.19; banding quantised to 0.1 steps.

name: topoMod2Pairing
doc: F2 pairing of cycles: overlapping generators cancel (xor), leftover is the class
draws: Two overlapping rings whose shared arcs cancel, leaving only the unshared arcs in magenta.
params: t: unused; centres (0.58,0.5) and (0.90,0.5); radius 0.18, width 0.03.

name: topoMorseBasin
doc: Morse basin of attraction: partition of the domain by the descending min
draws: The plane split into two coloured basins of attraction along a wavering boundary.
params: t: unused; flow bias from tGrad(p); two minima at fixed points.

name: topoMorseIndexColor
doc: Morse index: Hessian signature colours min / saddle / max at critical points
draws: Small coloured marks at critical points, amber, teal or magenta by Hessian sign, over a faint field.
params: t: unused; determinant and trace from tHessDet and tHessTr; critical threshold from tCrit.

name: topoMorseInequality
doc: Morse inequalities: c_k ≥ β_k drawn as count bars vs Betti bars
draws: Pairs of bars per level compare critical-count bars against Betti bars, sliding across the frame.
params: t: Betti bar height at level 2 (0.22 plus or minus 0.04); count bars fixed.

name: topoMorseSmaleComplex
doc: Morse–Smale cells: intersections of stable and unstable manifolds
draws: Curved cells coloured by gradient direction, ink flow lines, and amber critical points.
params: t: flow-line phase; cell angle quantised into six sectors; critical points from tCrit.

name: topoNerve1Skeleton
doc: 1-skeleton of the nerve: vertices for sets, edges for nonempty pairwise overlap
draws: Nine teal nodes joined by ink edges wherever their discs overlap, the overlap radius pulsing.
params: t: overlap radius 0.18 plus or minus 0.03 and node positions via tSite.

name: topoNerve2Skeleton
doc: filled 2-skeleton: every triple with common intersection is a triangle
functions: float topoTri(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b, vec2 c)
draws: A filled amber triangle over three nodes whose balls share a common point, with ink edges.
params: t: site positions via tSite; radius fixed at 0.20; sites 0, 3 and 6.

name: topoNormalizedLaplacian
doc: normalized Laplacian L_sym eigenbands: degree-weighted nodal sets
draws: A single amber nodal band over a teal-to-ink field, with a degree-weighted wobble.
params: t: unused; degree from tFbm(p*3); mode from tMode(p,2,2).

name: topoOffsetFiltration
doc: offset filtration of a curve: {x : dist(x,γ) ≤ r} growing tubular neighborhoods
draws: A wavy closed curve with a teal tube around it that widens and narrows.
params: t: tube radius r from 0.02 to 0.13 and curve wobble; centre (0.72,0.5).

name: topoOffsetNerve
doc: nerve of metric thickenings: as r grows, the nerve of {B(x,r)} fills
draws: A mint haze of growing discs joined by ink edges between neighbouring points.
params: t: disc radius r from 0.08 to 0.22 via tSite(i,t); seven fixed sites in a chain.

name: topoOpenCoverOverlap
doc: pairwise overlap regions U∩V of an open cover, the 1-simplices of the nerve
draws: Six translucent teal discs with saddle-coloured overlaps between neighbours.
params: t: disc radius 0.16 plus or minus 0.03 per index; overlap test at radius 0.16.

name: topoParallelTransport
doc: parallel transport / holonomy: a frame rotating around a closed loop
draws: A ring with a frame dot sliding around it and amber tick marks showing the holonomy.
params: t: frame rotation at 0.2 per unit; ring radius 0.22; holonomy scale from tGaussK at the centre.

name: topoPartitionOfUnity
doc: partition of unity subordinate to a cover: weights sum to 1, support in each set
draws: Three soft blobs blending teal, magenta and amber, with weights that sum to one.
params: t: blob centres via tSite(0,3,6); Gaussian falloff 18.

name: topoPersistenceBarcode
doc: persistence barcode: horizontal birth–death bars (H0 teal, H1 magenta) on filtration axis
draws: Three horizontal bars on an axis, two teal and one magenta, whose ends breathe.
params: t: bar end lengths; axis and bar positions fixed.

name: topoPersistenceDiagram
doc: persistence diagram: points (birth, death) above the diagonal, lifetime = death−birth
draws: Three dots above a diagonal in a framed plot, teal births and a magenta death, one dot drifting.
params: t: wobble of one birth point; axes fixed.

name: topoPersistenceHeatmap
doc: 2D density of persistence pairs in the birth–death plane
draws: A warm density smear of persistence pairs in the birth-death plane, slowly drifting.
params: t: slow drift of six hashed centres via tH22; kernel sharpness 55.

name: topoPersistenceImage
doc: persistence image: Gaussian kernels at (birth, persist) with a linear weighting
draws: A three-blob Gaussian density map in teal and magenta over paper.
params: t: second blob height wobble; kernel widths 38, 48 and 60.

name: topoPersistenceLandscape
doc: persistence landscapes λ_k(t): k-th largest tent min(t−b, d−t)_+ stacked
functions: float topoTent(float x, float b, float d)
draws: Three stacked tent curves filled in teal, mint and magenta above a baseline.
params: t: second tent right edge 0.58 plus or minus 0.06; baseline y=0.18.

name: topoPersistenceSilhouette
doc: persistence silhouette: weighted sum of landscape tents, one curve not a stack
functions: float topoSilTent(float x, float b, float d, float w)
draws: One weighted tent curve filled in mint, with an ink outline.
params: t: third tent position 0.4 plus or minus 0.04; tent weights 1.0, 0.7 and 0.45.

name: topoPresheafNotSheaf
doc: presheaf that fails the sheaf equalizer: local data glue on overlaps but not globally
draws: Two half-fields glued along an overlap band, with a wavering amber seam.
params: t: seam wave speed 2.0; overlap band between x 0.66 and 0.78.

name: topoPrimalDualMesh
doc: primal / dual mesh overlay: circumcentric dual of a triangular grid
draws: A triangular grid in ink with a saddle-coloured dual centre in each cell.
params: t: unused; grid density 5.5 by 4 cells.

name: topoPrincipalCurvature
doc: principal curvatures κ± = H ± sqrt(H²−K) as a two-direction hatch
draws: A teal and magenta tint that follows the two principal curvatures of a height field.
params: t: unused; kappa plus and minus from tMeanH and tGaussK; tanh scale 0.12.

name: topoPullbackCover
doc: Mapper pullback cover: preimages of overlapping intervals of the filter
draws: Two overlapping bands of a filter in teal and magenta, with an amber overlap.
params: t: band shift of plus or minus 0.08; band edges otherwise fixed.

name: topoRankFunction
doc: rank function of a persistence module: rank of the map H(s)→H(t) on the square s≤t
draws: A staircase of rank values over the upper triangle, shaded teal and magenta where rank exceeds one.
params: t: second step height 0.55 plus or minus 0.04; step positions fixed.

name: topoReducedBetti
doc: reduced homology: tilde β0 = β0−1, the extra point at −∞ removed
draws: Three bars with the first greyed out as the removed point at minus infinity, plus an amber ghost box.
params: t: teal bar length wobble; grey and magenta bars fixed.

name: topoReebGraphContours
doc: Reeb graph: isolines collapsed to points, saddles as branch nodes
draws: A Reeb graph of two teal nodes joined to an amber branch node, drawn over contour lines.
params: t: unused; six contour levels; branch node fixed at (0.78,0.50).

name: topoReebRadius
doc: Reeb graph metric thickening: a tubular neighborhood of the Reeb quotient
draws: a soft mint band wrapping the two ends of a Reeb branch, with a thin ink ring at its edge that swells and shrinks.
params: p: plane point. t: sets ring radius 0.05 plus or minus 0.03. No uniforms. Band centres fixed.

name: topoRestrictionExact
doc: exactness of the restriction sequence: ker(δ) = im(ε) as a cancelled overlap
draws: two overlapping open regions, with the overlap lit amber along a band where a sequence cancels out.
params: p: plane point. t: wobbles the left region edge by sin(t). Band location comes from the Morse field, not t.

name: topoRestrictionMap
doc: restriction maps r_{U⊂V}: arrows from a large open down to a smaller one
draws: a large disc with a smaller disc inside it, and eight rust spokes radiating from the small disc's centre.
params: p: plane point. t: unused, the picture is static. Spoke count fixed at 8.

name: topoRicciFlowLook
doc: Ricci-flow look: conformal factor e^{2u} evolving by ∂u/∂t = −R/2
draws: a paper-toned field whose contrast breathes as a conformal stretch, with death-red specks where curvature is negative.
params: p: samples Gauss curvature and Morse field. t: scales flow strength and speck fraction.

name: topoRips1Skeleton
doc: VR 1-skeleton only: the flag graph G_ε, no filled faces
draws: nine landmark dots joined by ink lines wherever two dots sit closer than a threshold that breathes over time.
params: p: plane point. t: threshold 0.28 plus or minus 0.08 decides which of the 36 site pairs are drawn.

name: topoRips2Fill
doc: VR triangles: fill every clique of three landmarks at the current scale
functions: float topoRipsTri(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b, vec2 c)
draws: an amber-rust filled triangle among three landmarks, shown only while all three of their edges are under the breathing threshold.
params: p: plane point. t: threshold 0.34 plus or minus 0.08 and site positions. The ok gate shows the triangle only when all three edges pass.

name: topoRipsFlag
doc: flag complex of VR: every clique of the 1-skeleton is promoted to a simplex
draws: nine landmark dots, with the best-connected ones glowing amber in proportion to how many neighbours they reach.
params: p: plane point. t: threshold 0.30 plus or minus 0.06. Amber weight is neighbour fraction. The doc promises clique filling but the code only colours by neighbour count.

name: topoScaleBirthEdge
doc: edges born at scale: an edge appears exactly when 2ε reaches d(i,j)
draws: a chain of eight segments where each one flashes amber for an instant as its length meets twice the sweeping scale, while the others stay ink.
params: p: plane point. t: scale eps = 0.06 plus 0.16 times fract(t times 0.08), so edges appear in a sweep. Endpoints use static t=0.

name: topoSectionalHint
doc: sectional curvature tint: K(X∧Y) from the graph Hessian on coordinate planes
draws: a paper field washed toward amber where the local Gauss curvature is positive and toward void where it is negative, shifting slowly.
params: p: samples Gauss curvature. t: modulates sign and strength by cos(0.3 t).

name: topoShapeOperator
doc: shape operator II(X,Y): hatch aligned to principal directions of the graph
draws: a paper field crossed by saddle-coloured hatch lines aligned to the graph's principal directions.
params: p: sets hatch direction from the Hessian and frequency 32. t: unused, static.

name: topoSheafHom
doc: Hom of stalks: pairing two stalk values as a bilinear colour mix
draws: an amber glow where two field values multiply to a high number, with birth-blue and death-red tints from each field alone.
params: p: samples Morse and terrain fields. t: unused. Weights 0.5 and 2.0 fixed.

name: topoSheafRestrictionFail
doc: sheaf restriction fail: colour jump where r_{U∩V}(s_U) ≠ r_{U∩V}(s_V)
draws: two overlapping discs, where the lens between them turns death-red wherever the two sections disagree on their overlap.
params: p: plane point. t: shifts section V by 0.15 sin(0.5 t), so the failure band comes and goes.

name: topoSheafSection
doc: global section attempt: a single colour that restricts to every open
draws: a mint plate where one global value stays consistent, with ink rings around four sites.
params: p: plane point. t: target level 0.45 plus or minus 0.08 sweeps the mint zone.

name: topoSkyscraperStalk
doc: skyscraper sheaf: a single stalk at x, zero elsewhere
draws: a single soft death-red spot at one point against paper, drifting slightly side to side.
params: p: plane point. t: sways x by 0.1 sin(0.3 t). Falloff 70 fixed.

name: topoSpectralClustering
doc: spectral clustering: k-means in eigen-coordinates, Voronoi of embedded centres
draws: the plane split into three coloured regions (birth, death, amber) by nearest spectral centre, with thin ink boundaries.
params: p: converts to two eigen-coordinates. t: moves the third centre by 0.1 sin(0.3 t). Centres otherwise fixed.

name: topoSpectralEmbedding
doc: spectral embedding: plane coloured by (φ₂, φ₃) eigen-coordinates
draws: the plane tinted by two eigenvector coordinates, from blue-grey through green-amber.
params: p: two eigen-modes set red and green channels. t: unused.

name: topoSplitTree
doc: split tree of a superlevel filtration: components split as α decreases
draws: a small tree: an amber root splitting into two ink-capped branches joined by death-red edges.
params: p: plane point. t: moves the left leaf height by 0.04 cos(0.4 t). Node positions otherwise fixed.

name: topoStalkMismatch
doc: stalk comparison: germs at a point from two opens disagree
draws: a single point where two readings disagree, shown as a death-red glow inside a birth-blue dot.
params: p: plane point. t: unused. Falloff 6 around a fixed point.

name: topoSublevelBands
doc: sublevel sets {x : f(x) ≤ α} as stacked bands; the moving isoline is component birth
draws: stepped bands of blue fading to paper where the function lies below a rising level, with a saddle-coloured iso-line marking that level.
params: p: plane point. t: level 0.12 to 0.74, swept sinusoidally. Quantisation 9 bands fixed.

name: topoSublevelComponents
doc: color sublevel components by which peak owns them (union-find / elder labels)
draws: the below-level region coloured in two peak-owned colours, blending into saddle colour where the two basins meet.
params: p: plane point. t: level 0.18 to 0.73. Merge band width fixed at 0.22 to 0.38.

name: topoSublevelGradientFlow
doc: gradient flow of the filtration function: streamlines into minima of the sublevel
draws: striped streamlines aligned with the gradient, drifting over time, drawn in birth blue over a Morse-coloured field.
params: p: plane point and gradient. t: stripe phase speed 0.8. Stripe frequency 28 fixed.

name: topoSuperlevelBands
doc: superlevel sets {x : f(x) ≥ α} swept high-to-low; peaks born first, elder rule implied
draws: the mirror of sublevel bands: amber-to-death bands above a level that falls from high to low.
params: p: plane point. t: level 0.72 down to 0.14. Eight bands fixed.

name: topoTripleLens
doc: triple ball intersection: the Čech 2-simplex as the common cap
draws: a single saddle-coloured lens where three fixed discs all overlap, breathing in radius.
params: p: plane point. t: radius 0.24 plus or minus 0.03. Uses only sites 0, 3 and 6.

name: topoTripleOverlap
doc: triple intersections U∩V∩W, the 2-simplices of the nerve
draws: death-red patches where three landmark discs overlap in a sliding triple, over a faint mint wash.
params: p: plane point. t: site positions. Radius fixed 0.22. Sliding triple over 7 windows.

name: topoUpperStar
doc: upper-star filtration: a cell enters when its lowest vertex does (dual of lower-star)
draws: a grid of square cells, each filled amber-to-death from its lowest corner, with ink cell edges and a cut level sweeping.
params: p: plane point. t: cut level 0.15 to 0.65, sinusoidal. Grid 10 by 7 fixed.

name: topoVietorisRipsScale
doc: Vietoris–Rips scale: edges when d(i,j)≤2ε, triangles when all three edges exist
draws: nine dots joined by ink lines that appear as a scale breathes. The doc promises triangles; the code draws only edges.
params: uScale (float, default 1): multiplies the threshold 2 eps. t: eps 0.08 to 0.20 breathing.

name: topoVoidBirthDeath
doc: H2 bars as nested void shells: inner birth, outer death of a cavity
draws: a paper disc with a void-coloured annulus between two ink rings, the inner ring birth-blue and the outer death-red.
params: p: plane point. t: inner radius 0.12 plus or minus 0.03. Outer radius fixed 0.34.

name: topoWassersteinGeodesic
doc: Wasserstein geodesic: interpolated diagrams γ(u)=(1−u)X+uY as points traveling matches
draws: two diagram segments sliding into each other while amber points ride along them.
params: p: plane point. t: interpolation u from sinusoid of 0.45 t. Endpoints fixed.

name: topoWassersteinSmear
doc: p-Wasserstein transport: mass smeared along matching edges with p-cost thickness
draws: two matched transport segments whose thickness grows with squared cost, with amber mass dots sliding along them.
params: p: plane point. t: sliding phase 0.5 t. Cost from fixed endpoints.

name: topoWedgeProduct
doc: wedge product α∧β: two 1-forms' parallelogram area as a 2-form density
draws: a paper field tinted birth-blue or death-red by the sign of a finite-difference cross product of two gradient fields.
params: p: plane point. t: unused. Sampling offset 0.1 fixed. Gain 0.2 fixed.

name: topoWitnessComplex
doc: witness complex: landmarks plus witness points that certify simplices
draws: six amber landmark dots and three mint witness dots, each witness joined by an ink line to a landmark.
params: p: plane point. t: witness positions via t plus 1.7 offset. Landmark positions by t.

name: topoWitnessLandmarks
doc: witness landmarks vs witnesses: two roles in the same point cloud
draws: Nine moving points on paper: amber larger disks for the landmarks and smaller mint disks for the witnesses, with a faint halo around the nearest landmark.
params: p: plate-space position; t: time moves the sites; every second site is a landmark.

name: ufoBloom
draws: A gold disc with a thick warm glow round it that fades smoothly into the night and never burns out to pure white.
params: base: colour under the glow; glow: emissive colour; d: signed distance to the emissive shape; r: halo radius in d units; uUfoBloomK: halo strength, 1 default.
doc: bloom from an emissive shape only: gaussian halo plus a wide skirt, then a soft knee that keeps the sum under white
functions: vec3 ufoBloom(vec3 base, vec3 glow, float d, float r)

name: ufoBolt
draws: A jagged vertical lightning bolt with a near-white core, a cyan body and a purple outer band, each a hard flat width, redrawn every second frame.
params: p: uv; a, b: bolt start and end; t: seconds, jag held to twos, the seed uUfoSeed picks the shape; uUfoBoltAmp: sideways jag amplitude in uv, 0.05 default. Returns rgb and coverage.
doc: stepped lightning: polyline jag redrawn on twos, bolt-white core, cyan body, purple edge band, three flat widths
functions: vec4 ufoBolt(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b, float t)

name: ufoCel3
draws: A seal-blue sphere cut into a cool violet-tinted shade, a flat mid and a warm lit cap by two hard terminators.
params: base: local colour; ndl: signed N.L in -1..1, the two cuts sit at -0.12 and 0.30 with one-pixel width.
doc: three-band cel at N.L -0.12 and 0.30, tones 0.58 / 0.80 / 1.0, shade shifted toward blue, light toward warm

name: ufoDunePlate
draws: A flat yellow desert in perspective strips, each dune a pale crest, a sand body and a jagged darker shadow edge, under a thin grey-green sky line.
params: p: uv, y up; uUfoDuneHz: horizon height 0..1 (0.87 then 0.82 in the packet); uUfoScroll: dune phase, drive from rig distance; uUfoSeed shifts the dune sines.
doc: desert plate: thin pale sky band over sine dune strips in sand hi / mid / shadow with a jagged two-value shadow contour

name: ufoEnumaWind
draws: A red spiral of five hard-edged arms whirling out from a point, deep crimson in the middle and a lighter red outward, turning in steps.
params: q: coordinates centred on the spiral, outer radius 1; t: seconds, rotation held to twos; uUfoArms: arm count, an integer (5); uUfoTwist: spiral tightness (6). Returns rgb and coverage.
doc: Enuma Elish wind: a logarithmic spiral of hard red arms turning on twos, hotter at the core, fading to nothing at the rim

name: ufoEye
draws: A narrow smirking eye with a coloured iris, a dark slit pupil and two hard white catch-lights; it flips to a red iris on cue.
params: q: eye-local coordinates, lens radius 1, y up; iris, irisLow: upper and lower-band iris colours; uUfoEyeHot: 0 normal, 1 red iris and red catch-light.
doc: half-lidded eye: cream lens, iris with a lower band, slit pupil, a hard upper-left highlight plus a small second
functions: vec4 ufoEye(vec2 q, vec3 iris, vec3 irisLow)

name: ufoFur
draws: Hard pointed fur tufts fringe the outer edge of a round seal body, each leaning its own way and jumping every second frame.
params: d: signed distance outside the body (>0 outside); ang: atan angle round the body centre; n: clump count, integer; len: longest clump length in d units; t: seconds, held to twos.
doc: fur as tapered contour clumps leaning off an SDF edge, each 0.01 to 0.04 H, redrawn on twos
functions: float ufoFur(float d, float ang, float n, float len, float t)

name: ufoGateWall
draws: A wall of round gold portals in three sizes, each a pale core inside bands of gold rings with an orange edge on one side, spaced wide apart so they never form a carpet.
params: p: uv, y up; t: seconds, rings turn on twos; uUfoGateR: near-layer radius in uv (0.065 is 0.13 H diameter); uUfoGateX: x beyond which no portal is drawn. Mid and far layers are 0.69 and 0.42 of that radius. Returns rgb and coverage.
doc: Gate of Babylon wall: three layers of flat gold ripple discs on a jittered grid, concentric ring bands, no ink line

name: ufoGrade
draws: The whole picture takes a cool teal cast in the lights and a warm black in the darks, or a cream-yellow wash in the desert.
params: c: linear colour in; uUfoWorld: 0 night split-tone, 1 desert split-tone; uUfoSplit: 0..1 strength of the tint (0.25 default).
doc: split-tone grade: night shadow #0b0504 and high #95d0d5, or desert shadow #c9be8d and high #f9fb98, then ink floor and 0.92 cap

name: ufoGrain
draws: A fine moving speckle and a faint paper tooth over the picture, jumping every second frame, quiet in the deepest darks and brightest lights.
params: c: colour in; p: uv; t: seconds, held to twos; mask: 0..1 where the grain applies (1 whole frame, 0 none); uUfoGrain: amplitude, 0.035 default.
doc: film grain and paper tooth held on twos, strongest in the mid-tones, masked so it can sit on the sky only
functions: vec3 ufoGrain(vec3 c, vec2 p, float t, float mask)

name: ufoInk
draws: A thin dark-blue outline round a cel sphere, heavier on the shadowed flank, with one lighter inner crease.
params: col: colour under the line; local: colour the line is derived from; d: signed distance to the stroke centre in uv; inner: 0 outer contour, 1 interior; shadow: 0..1 on the shadow side.
doc: coloured line: local colour x 0.32 floored at ink, 3.0 px outer contour, 1.4 px inner, +60 percent on the shadow side
functions: vec3 ufoInk(vec3 col, vec3 local, float d, float inner, float shadow)

name: ufoKit
draws: A noise-checkered night-blue and gold test pattern under the ink floor and the 0.92 luma cap.
params: uUfoSeed: integer seed for every ufo hash; p: aspect-corrected uv, y up; t: seconds, held to 12 fps by ufoHold.
doc: ufotable kit: Fate/Zero palette constants, 0.92 luma cap with ink floor (ufoOut), AA helpers, hold on twos, seeded hash and fbm

name: ufoNightSky
draws: A deep blue night sky with three hard-edged cloud bands, each catching a thin blue rim on its upper edge, and a bruised brown glow stepping in at the horizon.
params: p: uv, y up; t: seconds, cloud drift held to twos; uUfoSkyHz: horizon height 0..1; uUfoFlash: 0..1 lightning lift on the clouds and rims.
doc: painted night plate: flat navy zenith, four-step horizon ramp in the lowest 15 percent, three lightning-lit cloud bands

name: ufoWeaponCard
draws: A single straight steel blade, spear or axe in three flat tones, pale along its lit edge and near-black on the other, with a gold guard where the blade meets the grip.
params: q: card-local coordinates, weapon runs along +x from 0 to 1, y across; kind: 0 sword, 1 spear, 2 axe, keep it constant for one draw. Returns rgb and coverage.
doc: steel weapon card from an SDF: sword, spear or axe in a hard three-band ramp with a gold collar or guard
